  • Participate in project reviews and post-mortems;
  • Ensure partner satisfaction by maintaining transparency and rigorously tracking requests and necessary adjustments;
  • Participate in discussions with other leads and Director to share best practices and technical innovations;
  • Develop and optimize, in collaboration with your team, reusable tools and features to improve the efficiency of your project;
  • Contribute to the improvement of development processes and methods to optimize productivity and the quality of deliverables.

What we're looking for

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field, combined with experience deemed equivalent;
  • At least five (5) years of experience in video game programming;
  • Experience as a lead programmer or in a similar role;
  • Strong proficiency in C++ and optimization skills;
  • Proficiency with the Unreal game engine is a significant asset;
  • Good understanding of the various hardware and software layers involved in the execution of a video game;
  • Experience in mobile game development (a significant asset);
  • Excellent command of French and English (written and spoken). English skills are required to perform the job, as we collaborate with English-speaking partners;
  • Ability to travel internationally as needed.

What we value in our team

  • Ability to anticipate and manage risks throughout the development process;
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills to ensure projects are delivered on time;
  • Excellent communication and interdisciplinary collaboration skills;
  • Demonstrated curiosity about new technologies;
  • Proven strong team and project leadership skills;
  • Ability to motivate and mentor;
  • Strong analytical and synthesis skills, and the ability to communicate ideas clearly;
  • Excellent critical evaluation of a finished product;
  • Ability to question assumptions;
  • Diplomacy, patience, resourcefulness, organization, and attention to detail.

Come and make a difference with us!

Frima is looking for a Lead Programmer to join a multidisciplinary team on one of our co-development projects!

We are Frima, a video game development studio based in Quebec City and Montreal for over 20 years, bringing together hundreds of passionate talents united by a single ambition: to create unforgettable games across all platforms.

  • 4.5-day workweek, year-round. (Friday afternoons off);

  • Up to 7 weeks of vacation per year, sick days, and personal days: your well-being matters to us.
  • Comprehensive group insurance coverage starting the day you join;

Life at the studio

  • Access to chair massages, fresh fruit and snacks, a gym, sports activities, and more;

  • Close-knit, supportive, and inclusive teams—even when working remotely!
  • Come discover the rest for yourself!

Buscamos uma pessoa Analista de Sistemas para atuar em uma das squads responsáveis pela construção e evolução dos sistemas da organização.
A posição terá foco na análise de necessidades do negócio, especificação de soluções e acompanhamento de projetos de desenvolvimento, implantação, integração e automação. Os projetos utilizam principalmente Java, JavaScript, Angular e banco de dados Oracle.
Essa pessoa trabalhará em conjunto com analistas de negócios, desenvolvedores, profissionais de testes, fornecedores e demais stakeholders, garantindo que as entregas estejam alinhadas às necessidades dos usuários e aos objetivos da organização. Você irá trabalhar em uma das mais tradicionais instituições de ensino superior do Brasil!

Responsabilidades e atribuições
• Compreender necessidades, processos e regras de negócio, transformando-os em requisitos claros e gerenciáveis.
• Analisar e propor soluções de sistemas alinhadas aos objetivos da organização.
• Elaborar especificações funcionais e técnicas para aplicações desenvolvidas em Java, JavaScript e Angular.
• Analisar estruturas, consultas, integrações e impactos relacionados ao banco de dados Oracle.
• Avaliar os impactos das soluções nos sistemas existentes, processos, integrações, arquitetura e padrões técnicos.
• Apresentar as soluções ao time e aos stakeholders antes da entrada na esteira de desenvolvimento.
• Atuar com analistas de negócios na estruturação, no detalhamento e na priorização do backlog.
• Acompanhar as atividades de desenvolvimento, testes, homologação e implantação.
• Garantir que as soluções sejam executadas conforme o escopo, o prazo e o custo estabelecidos.
• Participar das cerimônias e reuniões da squad, contribuindo para o planejamento e a execução das atividades.
• Manter atualizados os requisitos, documentos e registros relacionados às entregas.
• Apoiar a implantação das soluções em produção, incluindo configurações, parametrizações e estabilização.
• Orientar usuários e esclarecer dúvidas sobre as funcionalidades dos sistemas.
• Identificar dependências e impactos relacionados às soluções desenvolvidas por outras squads.
• Apoiar a transferência de conhecimento para as equipes responsáveis pela sustentação e melhoria contínua.
• Acompanhar entregas realizadas por fornecedores e validar sua aderência aos requisitos.
• Propor melhorias nos processos de desenvolvimento, qualidade, integração e arquitetura.
• Compartilhar conhecimentos e boas práticas com a equipe.

Confere abaixo o que você vai precisar saber pra se dar bem nessa oportunidade!

CONHECIMENTOS EXIGIDOS

  • Ensino Superior completo em Tecnologia da Informação, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Administração com ênfase em TI ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência com análise de sistemas e levantamento de requisitos.

  • Conhecimento de aplicações desenvolvidas em Java.
  • Conhecimento de desenvolvimento web com JavaScript.
  • Conhecimento do framework Angular.
  • Conhecimento de banco de dados Oracle, incluindo modelagem, consultas SQL e criação de objetos.

raw.description:
We believe in bold ideas, diverse perspectives, and the drive to transform knowledge into impact. Here, your curiosity fuels progress, your voice shapes innovation, and your ambition helps redefine what’s possible within science and learning. About the Role:

We'rebuilding the systems that turn one of the world's largest scientific corpora intoresearchintelligence. That meansproductionNLP pipelines running over millions of journal articles, extracting entities, classifications, claim tuples, and summariesoptimizedfor use by downstream agentic applications.We'relooking for a senior data scientist to owndomain-specificcontentmodeling work end to end, from the eval set through the pipeline stage that ships it.

You'lljoin a small, senior team where data scientists own their models in production.You'llwrite the code, own the evaluations, ship the changes, and stay accountable for the outcomes. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to see their models through to real usersin a rapidly evolving market.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Design and build NLP enrichment pipelines that extract entities, classifications, claims, and summaries from scientificfull-textat scale.

  • Compare NLP approaches to extraction and enrichment against LLM-basedapproaches, andpick the right tool for each task. That means putting traditional NLP (NER, sequence labeling, classification), embedding-based retrieval, LLM prompting, and fine-tuned smaller models on the same table, and defending each choice with evaluation, cost, and operational tradeoffs. This is a core part of the job, not an occasional exercise.

  • Own evaluation. Build the golden setsin consultation with SMEs and vendors, choose the metrics, and make productive tradeoffs between speed, quality, and cost.

  • Contribute to agentic AI application work: tool-using systems that reason over the enriched corpus, where your NLP and evaluation background will shape how the agent grounds and defends its answers.

  • Work directly with editors, product managers, and engineers. Bring the modeling perspective into productdecisions, andtranslate stakeholderpushbackinto concrete modeling work.

Required Qualifications:

  • Strong NLP background across modern (LLMs, transformers, embeddings, retrieval) and classical (NER, classification, sequence labeling) approaches.You'vebuilt evaluationsand learned from the results.

  • Cleanpython. You are comfortable in exploratory notebooks and production repositories, and an engineer taking over a modeling output from you has a good head start.

  • A habit of comparing approaches and choosing the right one for the task. You can defend "prompt a large LLM" and "train a small classifier on 2,000 labels" with equal seriousness, back the choice with an eval and a costestimate, andknow what to do when performance drifts.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working with scientific or scholarly text.

  • Familiarity with AWS (S3, Batch, Lambda, SageMaker) and Parquet or Iceberg data lake patterns.

  • Experience running LLMs underreal costand latency budgets in production.

  • Some exposure to agentic AI applications: tool use, multi-step reasoning, guardrails, and evaluation of trajectories rather than single-turn outputs.

Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions. Powered by the Pindrop Intelligence Network, our unified trust platform helps enterprises answer three critical questions:

Is this identity synthetic? Detect AI-generated and manipulated voice and video.
Is this identity risky? Identify fraud, suspicious behavior, and other risk signals.
Is this identity known? Authenticate identities using voice, device, behavioral, and other signals.

Pindrop brings this intelligence together across purpose-built trust engines to help organizations make informed decisions in real time — protecting customers, workforce interactions, and emerging AI-driven interactions.

Pindrop protects billions of high-risk interactions for enterprises, including leading financial institutions, insurers, and healthcare organizations. Its technology is informed by more than 8 billion real-world interactions annually and protected by 300+ patents.

Recognized by TIME as one of the 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG.

What you’ll do

Depending on your level and domain expertise, as a Pindrop Research Scientist, you will drive core research initiatives, deliver reproducible experimental results, and help translate machine learning models into real-world product solutions. You may:

  • Conduct research to develop new functionalities and improve existing technologies across our core domains (Fraud, Voice/Speech, Video, Authentication, and Deepfake Detection).
  • Design, implement, and evaluate deep learning algorithms and ML models tailored to complex datasets.
  • Partner closely with research engineers and engineering teams to transition complex research prototypes into efficient, production-ready systems across cloud or edge environments.
  • Support targeted investigations by analyzing system behavior, identifying detection gaps, and recommending practical improvements for our customers.
  • Participate in cross-functional team meetings, contribute to regular research and code reviews, and publish patents and peer-reviewed papers in top conferences.

Who you are

  • You remain focused, persistent, and scientifically rigorous through multiple experimental iterations, navigating ambiguity in research data, quality, or shifting methodologies.
  • You seamlessly bridge the gap between research and engineering teams. You can explain complex AI/ML concepts with clarity to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • You take individual ownership of assigned research projects and workstreams, making sound technical decisions using available data, theory, and rigorous experimental evidence.
  • You follow through on your commitments, communicate research progress transparently, and maintain the highest standard of technical integrity, documentation, and model reproducibility.
  • You use machine learning frameworks effectively to design, train, and evaluate models, carefully validating outputs and applying sound judgment to balance experimentation speed with robustness, compliance, and model quality.

Your skill-set

Because this is a general pipeline for all levels, we welcome candidates with a variety of backgrounds. The qualifications we look for across our teams include:

  • Degree (Master’s or PhD) in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence) or equivalent industry research experience.
  • We hire across all levels—from early-career researchers (1-3 years) to highly tenured Senior/Principal Research Scientists (6+ years) focused on deep learning, computer vision, face recognition, generative AI, speech processing, or fraud modeling.
  • Strong programming proficiency in Python and hands-on mastery of modern machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Keras.
  • A proven track record of successful project delivery, publishing peer-reviewed research, or translating research findings into practical improvements (models, decision systems, or production recommendations).
  • Foundational or expert-level knowledge of biometrics, identity authentication, fraud patterns, audio/video pipelines, or consumer security concepts.

What’s in it for you

At Pindrop, research sits at the intersection of AI, voice, fraud, identity, and customer experience. You’ll turn real-world interaction data into insights that influence how our products evolve and how we help enterprises make better decisions.

  • Build expertise in an emerging category: Develop firsthand knowledge of voice intelligence, fraud prevention, authentication, and deepfake detection as these fields continue to evolve.
  • Work with real-world data at meaningful scale: Analyze complex calls, interactions, and behavioral patterns to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities that matter to customers.
  • Learn from experienced research and cross-functional teams: Partner with Research, Product, Engineering, Fraud Strategy, and Customer Experience leaders to understand how insights become better products and decisions.
  • Strengthen your research and analytical judgment: Develop your ability to identify patterns, evaluate evidence, ask sharper questions, and translate qualitative observations into clear recommendations.
  • See your work influence real outcomes: Your findings will help improve product quality, fraud detection, customer experiences, analyst performance, and the way Pindrop protects high-risk interactions.
  • Grow into a broader research professional: Build the communication, critical-thinking, problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills needed to take on increasing ownership and more complex research questions.

For more senior research roles, you will shift your emphasis toward owning the research agenda, shaping product and business strategy, influencing executive decisions, mentoring others, and defining how Pindrop creates differentiated insight.

What we offer

As a part of Pindrop, you’ll have a direct impact on our growing list of products and the future of security in the voice-driven economy. We hire great people and take care of them. Here’s a snapshot of the benefits we offer:

  • Competitive compensation package, including RSUs (Restricted Stock Units) for all employees, so everyone shares in our long-term success.
  • Remote-first environment - giving you flexibility and autonomy in how you structure your day.
  • While we work flexibly, we prioritize meaningful in-person moments through regular team on-sites, company-wide events, and intentional gatherings that foster connection, collaboration, and shared success.
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Generous health and welfare plans to choose from - including one employer-paid “employee-only” plan!
  • Best-in-class Health Savings Account (HSA) employer contribution
  • Low-cost vision and dental plans for you and your family, providing comprehensive coverage and peace of mind.
  • Paid Parental Leave - Including birth, adoptive & foster parents
  • One year of diaper delivery for your newest addition to the family! It’s our way of welcoming new Pindroplets to the family!
  • Recurring monthly phone and internet allowance to help cover essential connectivity costs and support flexible work.
  • Enhanced fertility and GLP-1 benefits to support family-building journeys and personalized health needs.
  • Annual Learning & Development stipend to support your professional growth, skill-building, certifications, and continued education.

Not sure if this is you?

We want a diverse, global team, with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job sounds great, but you’re not sure if you qualify, apply anyway! We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time.

AI - A Transformative Force

At Pindrop, we view artificial intelligence as a transformative force that, when harnessed responsibly, can unlock unprecedented value for our customers, partners and society and enable and empower us to continue to deliver cutting-edge technology to combat fraud and unblur the lines between what it means to be human versus machine.

Pindrop may use AI tools to help prioritize job applications for human review. The AI tool may analyze your work experience and skills to assess fit for the role, but does not consider your name or contact details. Applications with the strongest match to job requirements are prioritized for human review; not all applications may be individually reviewed.

Pindrop is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Here at Pindrop, it is our mission to create and maintain a diverse and inclusive work environment. As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, disability, marital and/or veteran status.

raw.description:
Technical Operations Specialist


About Us
Property Leads is a fast-growing performance marketing company specializing in connecting motivated homeowners with real estate investors, with expanding operations across home services and other consumer verticals.

We're a lean, fast-moving startup that values ownership, resourcefulness, and results. We operate across multiple marketing channels, manage a growing network of partners, and move quickly to capitalize on new opportunities.

We don't believe in unnecessary bureaucracy or meetings for the sake of meetings. We believe in hiring smart, capable people who can solve problems, take initiative, and make things happen. If you thrive in a dynamic environment where priorities evolve and your work has an immediate impact, you'll fit right in.

About the Role
We're looking for a technically savvy, highly organized operations generalist to help manage the day-to-day technical and operational needs of our growing business.

This is a hands-on role at the intersection of technical operations, partner tech operations, campaign execution, creative compliance, and process improvement. You'll work closely with our affiliate team, internal stakeholders, and external partners to ensure campaigns launch smoothly, technical integrations function properly, and operational workflows run efficiently.

You'll be responsible for everything from partner onboarding and technical troubleshooting to coordinating creative approvals, managing campaign configurations, and identifying opportunities to streamline processes.

We're not looking for someone who needs a rigid job description or constant direction. We're looking for someone who can juggle multiple priorities, recognize what needs attention, take ownership, and figure out how to get things done.

This is an operations-first role that requires strong technical aptitude, not a traditional software engineering position.

Key Responsibilities
1. Partner & Campaign Operations

  • Own the operational and technical setup of new partners, campaigns, and traffic sources, ensuring launches are accurate, timely, and seamless.
  • Work closely with the affiliate team and external partners to coordinate integrations, troubleshoot issues, and resolve technical or operational roadblocks.
  • Manage campaign configurations, tracking implementations, payout updates, and other technical adjustments across our platforms.
  • Support the implementation and maintenance of various partner integrations, lead delivery systems, and marketing technologies.
  • Serve as a reliable point of contact for operational and technical requests, communicating clearly and keeping projects moving without unnecessary delays.

2. Creative Approvals & Workflow Management

  • Manage high-volume creative approval workflows, coordinating between external partners, clients, and internal teams.
  • Track submissions, feedback, revisions, and approvals to ensure timely turnaround and accurate documentation.
  • Maintain organized records and processes to ensure campaigns meet internal requirements and client expectations.
  • Identify bottlenecks and develop more efficient systems for managing recurring approvals and operational requests.

3. Technical Troubleshooting & Support

  • Investigate and resolve tracking discrepancies, integration issues, data inconsistencies, and other technical challenges.
  • Perform quality assurance checks on partner setups, campaign launches, tracking, and lead delivery processes.
  • Collaborate with internal technical resources when necessary, while independently resolving issues within your scope.
  • Proactively monitor workflows and identify potential problems before they impact campaign performance or partner relationships.

4. Process Improvement & Automation

  • Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve operational workflows across teams.
  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate troubleshooting, streamline repetitive tasks, improve documentation, and increase overall efficiency.
  • Build and maintain organized processes that can scale as the company grows.
  • Help develop SOPs, internal resources, and reporting systems that reduce friction and improve execution.
  • Adapt quickly as new partnerships, channels, tools, and business priorities emerge.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience in technical operations, marketing operations, affiliate operations, ad operations, or a similarly technical and execution-focused role.
  • Strong technical aptitude and the ability to learn new platforms, troubleshoot integrations, and navigate unfamiliar systems independently.
  • Familiarity with performance marketing technologies, tracking platforms, APIs, pixels, or lead management systems is highly desirable.
  • Exceptional organizational skills and the ability to manage a high volume of requests, projects, and competing priorities without losing attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience using AI tools to improve productivity, solve problems, and optimize workflows. We want someone who actively explores how technology can make them more effective.
  • A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset. You don't wait for someone to tell you there's a problem or exactly how to solve it.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced startup environment where priorities can shift quickly and responsibilities aren't always neatly defined.
  • Strong sense of accountability and follow-through. If you own something, you see it through to completion.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal oversight while knowing when to communicate, collaborate, or escalate.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with affiliate tracking platforms such as TUNE, Everflow, or similar systems.
  • Familiarity with lead generation, ping/post integrations, call tracking, or performance marketing campaign setups.
  • Experience with workflow automation tools, CRM systems, or project management platforms.
  • Experience working directly with affiliate publishers, advertisers, or external marketing partners.
  • Familiarity with data analysis, reporting, or basic API troubleshooting.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 90 days, success means:

  • Seamless partner launches: New partners, campaigns, and integrations are set up accurately and efficiently, with minimal delays or unnecessary back-and-forth.
  • Operational ownership: The affiliate team and external partners can rely on you to handle technical requests, troubleshoot issues, and keep workflows moving without constant follow-up.
  • Efficient creative approvals: High-volume approval processes are organized, responsive, and consistently managed.
  • Proactive problem-solving: You're identifying issues, anticipating needs, and resolving operational bottlenecks before they become larger problems.
  • Smarter processes: You've identified and implemented meaningful improvements, including AI-powered efficiencies and automation where appropriate.
  • Independence and adaptability: You've demonstrated that you can manage competing priorities, pivot quickly, and take ownership of new challenges with minimal oversight.

The Bottom Line
We're looking for someone who is equal parts technical, operational, and resourceful. Someone who can manage the details, solve problems, keep people aligned, and make sure things get done. This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in a growing company, take ownership of important processes, and help build the operational infrastructure that supports our next stage of growth.

Salary: $2,500 – $3,500 / month

raw.description:
This is a U.S. based position. All of the programs we support require U.S. citizenship to be eligible for employment. All work must be conducted within the continental U.S.

Who we are:

Raft ( is a customer-obsessed non-traditional defense tech company dedicated to empowering U.S. military and government agencies with cutting-edge AI/ML and data solutions. We are a leader in autonomous data fusion and Agentic AI, with a purposeful focus on Distributed Data Systems, Platforms at Scale, and Complex Application Development. With headquarters in McLean, VA, our range of clients includes innovative federal and public agencies leveraging design thinking, cutting-edge tech stack, and cloud-native ecosystem. We build digital solutions that impact the lives of millions of Americans.

About the role:

As a Help Desk Manager, you will lead technical support operations for secure, mission-critical platform services supporting the United States Space Force (USSF). You will oversee incident resolution, technical troubleshooting, and support workflows while providing advanced Tier II and Tier III support across complex infrastructure, applications, and networking environments. You will collaborate with engineering teams, stakeholders, and customers to ensure system reliability, improve service delivery, and drive continuous improvement in support operations.

What You Will Do

  • Lead help desk operations, establish support priorities, and manage technical troubleshooting and escalation workflows.
  • Provide advanced Tier II and Tier III technical support for complex hardware, software, networking, and platform-related issues.
  • Diagnose and resolve technical incidents, outages, and system performance issues through remote troubleshooting and direct user support.
  • Evaluate incident severity, complexity, and mission impact to determine appropriate prioritization and escalation paths.
  • Collaborate with platform engineers, developers, and cybersecurity teams to troubleshoot recurring issues, identify root causes, and implement lasting solutions.
  • Review system configurations, installations, and service changes to ensure successful deployment and production stability.
  • Improve system availability and reduce Mean Time to Repair (MTTR) through proactive maintenance, incident analysis, and process improvements.
  • Develop and maintain troubleshooting procedures, knowledge base documentation, support tools, and operational best practices.
  • Provide technical guidance, mentorship, and training to help desk personnel and customers.
  • Communicate incident status, technical risks, resolutions, and service improvements to customers, stakeholders, and leadership.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives involving support automation, incident management, and customer service delivery.
  • Provide technical consultation and support for critical incidents outside normal business hours as needed.

What we are looking for:

  • Bachelor's degree with 2–4 years of relevant experience, Master's degree with 0–2 years, or high school diploma with 8–10 years of relevant experience.
  • Demonstrated experience in technical support, help desk operations, IT service management, or related fields.
  • Experience coordinating technical support teams, managing incident priorities, and overseeing escalation workflows.
  • Advanced troubleshooting skills across computer hardware, operating systems, enterprise applications, and networking technologies.
  • Experience providing Tier II and Tier III technical support for complex systems and production environments.
  • Strong understanding of incident management, root-cause analysis, problem management, and service reliability practices.Experience with ticketing systems, knowledge management tools, and technical support documentation.
  • Familiarity with IT service management (ITSM) principles, service-level agreements, and continuous process improvement.
  • Ability to analyze complex technical problems, identify effective solutions, and coordinate resolution across multiple engineering teams.
  • Strong customer service, communication, organizational, and technical leadership skills.
  • Experience supporting DoD, federal, or other regulated environments.
  • Ability to provide technical guidance and training to both technical and non-technical users

Clearance Requirements:

  • Secret clearance required

Salary Range: $100,000.00 - $120,000.00

Work Type:

  • Remote with a preference for candidates based in Colorado Springs, CO
  • Foreign and domestic travel up to 35% to customer sites

What we will offer you:

  • Highly competitive salary
  • Fully covered healthcare, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k) and company match
  • Take as you need PTO + 11 paid holidays
  • Education & training benefits
  • Generous Referral Bonuses
  • And More!

Our Vision Statement:

We bridge the gap between humans and data through radical transparency and our obsession with the mission.

Our Customer Obsession:

We will approach every deliverable like it's a product. We will adopt a customer-obsessed mentality. As we grow, and our footprint becomes larger, teams and employees will treat each other not only as teammates but customers. We must live the customer-obsessed mindset, always. This will help us scale and it will translate to the interactions that our Rafters have with their clients and other product teams that they integrate with. Our culture will enable our success and set us apart from other companies.

How do we get there?

Public-sector modernization is critical for us to live in a better world. We, at Raft, want to innovate and solve complex problems. And, if we are successful, our generation and the ones that follow us will live in a delightful, efficient, and accessible world where out-of-box thinking, and collaboration is a norm.

Raft’s core philosophy is Ubuntu: I Am, Because We are. We support our “nadi” by elevating the other Rafters. We work as a hyper collaborative team where each team member brings a unique perspective, adding value that did not exist before. People make Raft special. We celebrate each other and our cognitive and cultural diversity. We are devoted to our practice of innovation and collaboration.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Fully remote | Working directly with the CEO | Monthly compensation in USD

About Us

We are a startup where priorities can change quickly, processes are still developing and several important initiatives often run in parallel. We are looking for someone who enjoys this environment and can bring structure, calm and reliable execution to a busy working day. Our work spans HR, finance, IT and marketing, with AI playing a practical role in how we organise information, coordinate work and improve processes.

Job Description

As Executive Assistant to the CEO, you will be a trusted right hand who turns priorities into clear actions and follows them through to completion. You will anticipate needs, organise competing demands, coordinate people and maintain a reliable overview of what requires attention across the business.

Inbox and calendar management form part of the role, alongside broader responsibility for organising projects, improving workflows, preparing decisions and keeping commitments on track.

You should bring practical experience using AI to accomplish meaningful work. This includes creating and using reusable AI skills: structured instructions, relevant context and tools that help an AI assistant perform recurring tasks consistently. You should be comfortable adapting these workflows, checking their outputs and recognising when human judgement or specialist input is needed.

You should be comfortable with the pace, uncertainty and pressure that can come with building a startup. This means adapting when plans change, handling competing requests and maintaining sound judgement under time pressure. You will help the CEO and team set realistic priorities, make trade-offs and identify when workload or deadlines need to be adjusted.

Key Responsibilities

  • Translate the CEO's priorities into actionable plans with clear owners, deadlines and follow-up.
  • Maintain an overview of ongoing initiatives, identify dependencies and flag delays or decisions early.
  • Coordinate work across the startup team, external partners and service providers.
  • Prepare concise research, meeting briefs, comparisons and recommendations that support decisions.
  • Organise meetings, correspondence and schedules, capturing decisions and ensuring agreed actions are completed.
  • Support HR operations through recruitment coordination, onboarding, documentation and follow-up.
  • Support finance operations by organising invoices, expenses, payment schedules and information needed by accounting specialists.
  • Support marketing initiatives by organising briefs, assets, deadlines and collaboration with internal and external contributors.
  • Coordinate IT requests, access requirements, software subscriptions and communication with technical colleagues.
  • Organise and improve how the CEO and startup team use Microsoft 365, keeping communication, documents, tasks and shared information structured and accessible.
  • Connect Microsoft tools with suitable AI skills and workflows, respecting permissions and confidentiality.
  • Create, adapt and maintain AI skills and repeatable workflows for research, reporting, documentation and operational coordination.
  • Check AI-generated work for accuracy, relevance and completeness before it is used.
  • Keep business information organised and handle confidential matters with discretion.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience in executive assistance, business operations, project coordination or a comparable role involving substantial ownership.
  • A working understanding of HR, finance, IT and marketing, sufficient to coordinate tasks, ask informed questions and recognise when specialist expertise is required.
  • Strong practical experience with Microsoft 365, particularly Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to organise collaboration across these tools, including shared documents, structured information, task tracking and access coordination.
  • Confidence using Excel to maintain operational overviews, reconcile information and prepare clear reports.
  • Practical experience creating or configuring reusable AI skills and applying them to real work.
  • Ability to explain a workflow you personally implemented, including how you checked its results and handled its limitations.
  • Strong prioritisation and follow-through, including the ability to manage several workstreams without constant reminders.
  • Clear written and verbal communication in English.
  • Confidence working with spreadsheets, documents, shared knowledge systems and task management tools.
  • Sound judgement about confidentiality, access permissions and the information shared with AI tools.
  • Willingness to take responsibility, resolve routine issues independently and escalate significant risks promptly.
  • Resilience and adaptability in a startup environment, including changing priorities, incomplete information and periods of high workload.
  • Ability to remain calm, communicate clearly and maintain quality under pressure.
  • A practical approach to solving problems and taking ownership when established processes or clear instructions are not yet available.
  • Confidence raising capacity constraints early, proposing realistic alternatives and clarifying which tasks take priority.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Working directly with a founder or supporting a small startup team.
  • Improving processes that span several business functions.
  • Using AI agents, tool integrations or automation platforms to reduce repetitive work.
  • Hands-on experience with Power Automate, Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio to build useful automations and AI assistants.
  • Building reusable procedures and shared knowledge that other team members can use.
  • Coordinating recruitment, financial administration, suppliers or marketing delivery.

What We Offer

  • Close collaboration with the CEO and visibility across the startup.
  • Meaningful ownership of operational work and process improvements.
  • A broad role combining executive support, team coordination and practical AI use.
  • A fully remote working arrangement.
  • Monthly compensation in USD.

Remote Working Arrangement

You will work remotely and maintain clear visibility of priorities, progress and blockers. Reliable communication, organised documentation and consistent follow-through are essential. Working hours and required availability will be agreed during the hiring process.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and describe relevant examples of work you have personally delivered. Include an AI skill or workflow you created or substantially adapted, the business task it supported, and how you ensured the result was useful and reliable. An example of coordinating work across different business functions would also be helpful.

raw.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London OR UK Remote | 💰 £95,000 - £115,000 + Benefits | Hear from the team ✨

💼 The Team

If you love driving ambitious PR strategies, across multiple European markets outside of the UK and are passionate about what Monzo is doing, this could be the role for you! We're looking for an experienced PR professional to join our team as a Senior PR and Communications Manager (12 month fixed term contract) for Expansion Markets to help us bring Monzo to more people in more places.

You will have strong experience managing successful PR activities and campaigns in markets beyond the UK. You’ll have the ability to run the day-to-day PR activity in already established markets whilst also planning and executing PR launches in brand new markets and supporting in-market leadership profiling.

In this role, you will work closely with multiple teams including marketing, social, influencer, product and Monzo’s leadership team. You’ll devise and execute PR strategies that support business goals and showcase the best of Monzo in other markets. You'll need the ability to multitask managing multiple campaigns and market launches at the same time as well as having exceptional stakeholder management and collaboration skills.

This role is for a strategic planner and doer, you can see the big picture but are not afraid to get your hands dirty and approach projects in a collaborative manner.

You'll report to the Director of Corporate Communications and will manage an EU PR Manager based in Spain.

🔑You’ll play a key role by…

  • Planning and executing all PR activity in already established European markets, Ireland and Spain.
  • Leading and implementing our go-to-market PR strategy for Monzo in all new markets across EU. This includes establishing resources, building a launch plan and running the day-to-day.
  • Finding creative ways to get Monzo regularly into consumer press through big campaigns and smaller reactive, locally relevant news jumps.
  • Balance global campaigns with localised stories to ensure consistency and locally relevant content.
  • Managing spokespeople and acting as a strategic advisor to senior leaders on external communications, media training, engagement, and storytelling.
  • Collaborating cross-functionally with product, commercial, and operations teams to uncover and amplify compelling PR opportunities.
  • Managing current international agencies and team members whilst also resourcing and setting us up for success in new EU markets.
  • Building strong relationships with key media and journalists, while managing incoming press enquiries.
  • Using data and insights to inform and adapt strategy for our international expansion efforts.
  • Establishing new processes and ways of working in new markets.
  • Staying ahead of industry and relevant policy trends and developments to inform strategy and maintain thought leadership.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if you have…

  • Proven experience leading both tailored and scalable PR strategies for multiple international markets.
  • Experience launching brands with little brand awareness in new markets across Europe.
  • A track record of building and managing high-performing teams.
  • Strong experience working with and managing external agencies across multiple markets.
  • Ability to understand local media, audience nuances and adapt strategy based on this.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments.
  • Ability to demonstrate creativity and impact in delivering standout PR campaigns.
  • Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • A genuine passion for Monzo’s mission and an excitement to help bring it to more customers around the world!

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰 £95,000 - £115,000

📍 This role can be based in our London or Cardiff office, or distributed working within the UK (with meetings in London and potential international travel).

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.

📚 Substantial learning budget each year for executive development, conferences, and industry engagements.

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide comprehensive support for your work-from-home setup.

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps

  • Phone call with Recruiter (30 mins)
  • Video interview with team member (30 mins)
  • Technical & behavioural video interview (60 mins)
  • Leadership final (30 mins)

Our average process takes around 3–4 weeks, but we will always work around your availability.

We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊

The Government Affairs Director, is responsible for identifying, assessing and helping shape emerging sustainability, chemicals and product-related policy developments that could materially impact Cytiva's business, products, operations and growth. The role facilitates cross-functional evaluation of regulatory risks and opportunities, coordinates company responses to significant policy changes, and supports the development of advocacy strategies that protect and advance Cytiva's long-term business interests.


This position reports to the Global Head of Government Affairs and Policy and is part of the Legal function and is a remote role based in Brussels.


In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Lead the identification and assessment of emerging sustainability, chemicals and product-related policy developments, translating complex regulatory changes into clear business implications and strategic recommendations.
  • Serve as the company's subject matter expert on priority policy issues, providing timely analysis and advice to senior leaders on risks, opportunities and potential business impacts.
  • Establish and coordinate cross-functional teams to evaluate and respond to significant regulatory developments, ensuring alignment across Government Affairs, Legal, Regulatory Affairs, Sustainability, Supply Chain and Commercial functions.
  • Develop and support advocacy strategies on priority issues, working closely with trade associations, industry coalitions and government affairs colleagues to help shape policy outcomes and protect Cytiva's interests.
  • Build and maintain effective relationships with key external stakeholders, including industry associations, regulators, policymakers and partner organisations, to strengthen the company's visibility and influence on critical policy issues.
  • Provide horizon scanning and early warning of emerging legislative, regulatory and geopolitical developments that could impact Cytiva's products, operations, supply chain or long-term growth strategy.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Long-standing experience in life sciences government affairs, public policy, regulatory affairs, sustainability policy, chemicals policy, environmental policy, or a related field, with a Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline.
  • Experience leading cross-functional projects or governance processes involving Legal, Regulatory Affairs, Sustainability, Supply Chain, Commercial or other business functions as well as experience of working with government affairs colleagues in different regions and juridictions in a multinational matrix organisation.
  • Experience representing an organization through life sciences trade associations, industry coalitions, government consultations, or regulatory engagement activities.
  • Experience working across multiple geographic regions, including Europe, North America and Asia-Pacific, on policy, regulatory or government affairs issues.
  • Experience supporting business responses to major regulatory or legislative changes, including cross-functional governance and implementation planning.

This project is for a global leader in medical and travel security risk services, helping organisations protect their people wherever they work and travel. Travellers and expatriates use these apps to receive location-based medical and security alerts, access country risk information, check in, and contact 24/7 assistance centres with a single tap. The backend is already in place, allowing the team to focus on building a fast, secure and accessible native experience. When someone faces a crisis abroad, the app needs to work reliably when it matters most.

Role – how you’ll contribute

  • Develop and maintain the native iOS application using the latest Swift and SwiftUI. Write clean, scalable, and well-documented code;
  • Collaborate with product managers, backend developers, designers, and other stakeholders on requirements review, suggest solutions and estimate efforts to build user-friendly applications;

  • Take ownership of features and modules end to end, review peers' code against team standards, and contribute to technical design discussions;
  • Update internal knowledge base and operational documentation.

Expectations – the experience you need

  • 3+ years of experience in native iOS development using Swift and SwiftUI;
  • Solid understanding of Swift concurrency, including async/await, actors and data race prevention;
  • Experience implementing location services and push notifications;
  • Experience with OAuth 2.0/OIDC, session management and secure credential storage;
  • Experience integrating third-party frameworks;
  • Hands-on experience writing and maintaining unit and UI tests;
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines;
  • Proven ability to own features end to end, support production applications and resolve incidents;
  • Experience working closely with architects and reviewing other engineers’ code;
  • Familiarity with Scrum, Jira and Confluence;
  • Strong attention to detail, communication and problem-solving skills, with a commitment to continuous learning;

  • Travels related to international projects

  • Access* to language classes

*The availability and terms of individual benefits may vary depending on the chosen form of cooperation.

  • Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.

  • Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.

  • Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.

  • Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.

  • Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.

We look forward to welcoming your application.

Medicine moves forward here. So will you.

Our teams help clients navigate complex regulations while keeping patient safety at the center of every decision, from early development through to post-marketing surveillance. Increasingly, the value we create is not only in processing safety data but in interpreting it: spotting the signal that matters early and turning it into insight our clients can act on.

That work takes curious minds, problem-solvers and experts who care about getting it right. It also takes a culture worth staying for. Across Europe, North America, South America, Asia and Australia, we work in an environment built on kindness, flexibility, growth and belonging, where colleagues support one another and good ideas are heard wherever they come from.

If you want a role with real purpose, global reach and the chance to keep growing while you help protect patients, you will feel at home here. We would love to hear from you.

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

This is a 6-month PRN contract. Ideal candidates will have 20+ hours of availability per week, including some weekends. Must hold a current, unrestricted license in any US state/district. If hired, candidates must be willing and able to obtain additional licensure as needed.

The Minute Clinic Virtual Care Nurse Practitioner (Provider) delivers patient care services through a remote technology platform. You will work in collaboration with a dedicated team of professionals as you independently provide holistic, evidenced based care inclusive of accurate assessment, diagnosis, treatment, management of health problems, health counseling, and disposition planning for our patients ranging in age 18 months and above.

WORKING ENVIRONMENT:

  • Dedicated virtual care providers must meet minimum requirements for remote care delivery, including: broadband connectivity, a quiet setting with a neutral background to conduct visits from, and the ability to uphold patient privacy per CVSH guidelines. Ability to hardwire into connection preferred.

  • While performing the duties of the job, the employee is regularly required to interact with customers in a remote manner, site, write, operate the computer and phone, speak intelligibly, and hear patient responses.

  • Specific vision abilities include the ability to view and read a computer screen and other electronic devices

Responsibilities:

  • Provide holistic, evidenced based care inclusive of accurate assessment, diagnosis, treatment, management of health problems, health counseling, and disposition planning for our patients. This includes education and treatment for pregnancy prevention, STI Prevention and safer sex practices.

  • Evaluate primary care, acute, chronically ill, and transitional care patients, in addition to providing healthcare education and counseling, and disposition planning for our patients ranging in age 18 months and above.

  • Provide patient counseling; inclusive of pregnancy prevention, STI Prevention/safer sex practices, contraceptive care counseling and medication management

  • Educate patients on health maintenance and respond to patient care inquiries

  • Document all patient care within an EHR according to MinuteClinic policies and procedures

  • Provide care and coordination of our patients with internal and external colleagues, including the broader patient centered medical home, ensuring the highest standard of care is provided for all patients.

  • Effectively work within a patient care team, including fellow Providers, Collaborative Physicians, paraprofessionals, Pharmacists and other members of the health care team

  • Work independently , prioritize and solve problems, take initiative, and advocate for their patients and their practice

Required Qualifications:

  • Candidates must have active, unrestricted licensure in any US state/district.

  • Minimum of two years of medically-relevant experience or equivalent

  • Effective verbal, written, and electronic communication skills

  • Outstanding organizational skills and ability to multi-task

  • Initiative, problem solving ability, adaptability and flexibility

  • Ability to work without direct supervision and practice autonomously

  • Is proficient with information management and technology

  • Capacity to collaborate with professional colleagues as necessary to provide quality care

  • Depending on the market, the ability to be proficient in both speaking and writing in additional languages not limited to but including Spanish may be required

Education:

Completion of a Master’s Degree level Family Nurse Practitioner program with current National Board Certification and State of Employment license to practice in the Advanced Practice Nurse role required

$37.66 - $108.15

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above.

We're hiring a full-cycle Recruiter to support hiring across the company. You'll own your requisitions from intake through close: partnering with hiring managers to define the search, sourcing and assessing candidates, running the interview process, and negotiating and closing offers. You'll manage your own pipeline and workload across a variety of functions, and advise hiring managers on market conditions, candidate fit, and compensation.

Remote position; standard computer-based work with extended periods of sitting. Reasonable accommodations are available for individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role. Travel expectations for this role are 0–10%.

About IonQ:

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.

Location: This position can work onsite or hybrid from one of our offices in the US or fully remote.
Travel: Up to 10%
Job ID: 1961

The Role:

IonQ's Legal team supports the company's global legal affairs, including intellectual property, corporate and securities matters, commercial contracting, regulatory compliance, and enterprise risk management. As IonQ scales its quantum computing, networking, sensing, and fabrication businesses, we're building a dedicated product legal function to partner directly with product, research, engineering, and go-to-market teams from the earliest stages of development, and this role is foundational to that effort.

As Associate General Counsel, Product, you'll report to the Head of Product Legal and serve as a trusted legal partner to the teams building IonQ's products, in a role defined not by practice area but by impact: if a matter shapes how IonQ's products are designed, built, or brought to market, the product legal team helps get it done. The successful candidate will bring deep strategic partnership expertise for technology products alongside the drive to take complex, technology-driven transactions across the finish line.

Responsibilities:

  • Counsel IonQ's product and research teams, providing practical, business-calibrated legal guidance across the full product lifecycle — with strategic transactions and partnerships as signature areas of expertise
  • Draft, negotiate, and execute complex technology-driven transactions that directly advance IonQ's product strategy, including strategic partnerships, licensing, joint development, and supply and manufacturing arrangements
  • Shape the playbooks, processes, and infrastructure of a new product legal function designed to scale with the business
  • Collaborate closely with product, research, engineering, finance, privacy, compliance, trade, and other cross-functional stakeholders, as well as outside counsel
  • Translate in both directions — distill complex legal concepts into clear, actionable guidance for non-lawyers, and render product, engineering, and business strategy in terms that sharpen product legal's advice and priorities

Requirements:

  • A J.D. from an accredited law school and active membership in good standing in at least one U.S. state bar (or eligibility for in-house/registered counsel status in your state of employment)
  • 8+ years of relevant experience at a leading law firm and/or in-house legal department
  • Substantial experience advising on strategic partnerships for the manufacturing, distribution, and sale of technology products, both in the US and abroad
  • A proven track record of drafting, negotiating, and executing complex technology transactions with direct impact on business or product strategy
  • Demonstrated versatility — the range to move between product and transactional matters, and the mindset to build your skills on matters outside your core practice areas
  • An appetite for genuinely novel legal questions — the judgment to advise confidently amid ambiguity, and the drive to work where technology is unprecedented and legal frameworks are still being written
  • A desire to become a force-multiplier for your team, uncovering new opportunities for speed and efficiency — including leveraging existing AI tools and helping to build superior ones

Preferred Qualifications:

  • In-house legal experience with a mature US technology company
  • Experience specific to hardware products or hardware-focused businesses
  • Experience supporting post-acquisition integration of products, technologies, or businesses
  • Proficiency with multiple languages

The total compensation package includes base, bonus, equity, and a range of benefit options found on our career site.

If this role has a commission structure, the compensation range below just reflects the base compensation range.

Wage Transparency:
$160,000—$200,000 USD

Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment.

At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. We are dedicated to creating an environment where individuals can feel welcomed, respected, supported, and valued.

We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

US Technical Jobs. The position you are applying for will require access to technology that is subject to U.S. export control and government contract restrictions. Employment with IonQ is contingent on either verifying “U.S. Person” (e.g., U.S. citizen, U.S. national, U.S. permanent resident, or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum) status for export controls and government contracts work, obtaining any necessary license, and/or confirming the availability of a license exception under U.S. export controls. Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.

US Non-Technical Jobs. With high-quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can deliver more natural, accurate, and contextually rich Amharic experiences across education, accessibility, and global communication. That training data begins with you—your expertise will help power the next generation of AI.

On a typical day, you will review and annotate Amharic content, assess AI-generated outputs for accuracy and fluency, identify and document error patterns, and collaborate with our team to refine prompts, evaluation methods, and linguistic guidelines.

Fluency in Amharic is required, along with demonstrated experience in translation, linguistics, language teaching, editing, or related professional work. Experience in training, coaching, or linguistic annotation is a plus. Clear communication skills, cultural knowledge, and attention to detail are essential.

Ready to channel your Amharic expertise into building the AI tools of tomorrow? Apply today and help shape the model that will support millions of Amharic speakers worldwide.

raw.title: Manager, ML Solutions Architecture - Token Factory
raw.excerpt: About Nebius:Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy.
raw.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

This position sits within Nebius Token Factory, our serverless platform for running and customizing open-source LLMs in production. Token Factory allows for serverless inference and fine-tuning backed by in-house optimizations like custom speculative decoding, quantization, cache-aware routing and dedicated endpoints. Customers come to us to move from prototype to scaled production without the cost and complexity of building and tuning their own inference stack.

Our Solutions Architects own the technical delivery of customer engagements: deploying open-source models, tuning the serving stack, benchmarking against the customer's success criteria, and carrying the technical relationship through to production. Sales Engineers qualify and scope the opportunity; SAs execute it. Technical Account Managers take it from production onward.

We're looking for a Manager, ML Solutions Architecture to lead our US regional SA teams. Your scope is PoC delivery and post-sales technical support: the people who do it, the standard they do it to, and the operating cadence that keeps it predictable. You will report to the Head of Solutions Architecture and partner with a peer manager in the other region.

We expect you to push people when they need pushing, make the uncomfortable call when deliverables don't land even though the effort was real, and take ownership of the documentation work: implement and monitor the following of the guidelines, ticket hygiene, and making sure the team actually uses all three.

You're welcome to work remotely from the United States.

Your responsibilities will include:

Lead the team

  • Manage a team of 4 Solutions Architects, with continued growth planned: 1:1s, goal setting, performance reviews, promotion cases, and individual growth plans
  • Build an accurate picture of each SA's strengths, gaps, and preferences, and allocate accounts and engagements against both expertise and interest
  • Run the cadence that surfaces blockers early, then take them to the development, product, and business teams that can clear them, and stay on them until they do
  • Hold people to outcomes: distinguish effort from delivered results, say so plainly when the two diverge, and reflect it in ratings and compensation decisions
  • Onboard new joiners through to their first independently delivered engagement
  • Coach SAs into stronger engineers and stronger communicators, and make deliberate calls about who is ready for more scope

Own delivery

  • Be accountable for your team's delivery outcomes: time from PoC kick-off to first optimized dedicated endpoint, success-criteria hit rate, and the quality of the technical relationship after the customer goes to production
  • Review technical work before it reaches the customer: benchmarking methodology, serving configurations, results, closure documents; catch the wrong conclusion drawn from a metrics artifact before a customer sees it
  • Ensure staffing and escalation coverage across accounts and timezones, including post-sales request load that does not respect sprint boundaries
  • Call infeasibility early and with evidence, rather than letting the team burn iterations against requirements the platform cannot meet today

Own the operating system of the team

  • Maintain and extend the team's documentation: responsibilities, runbooks, guides, onboarding, definitions of done, engagement closure templates. Keep it accurate and reachable; link, don't copy
  • Get it used, not just written: documentation nobody reads is a cost, not an asset
  • Keep the ticket tracker the system of record, so PoC and production status is readable without asking anyone
  • Instrument the work: define and report the metrics that show whether delivery is getting faster and more reliable over time

Work across teams

  • Development and research teams: convert recurring customer pain into prioritized platform work, and represent the customer's technical reality in roadmap discussions
  • Pre-sales: hold the scoping-to-execution boundary: push back on under-scoped engagements, and feed feasibility signal back upstream
  • Account management: make production handoffs uneventful, and keep post-sales technical requests moving
  • Business and leadership: give a straight read on account health, technical feasibility, and capacity needs

We expect you to have:

  • 3+ years managing technical teams, including performance management and difficult conversations
  • Experience managing a customer-facing team. Running a team whose work is visible to customers, on customer timelines, with customer escalations.
  • Strong ML knowledge: LLM architectures, fine-tuning approaches (SFT/LoRA, RL-based), evaluation design, and a working command of inference internals — quantization, KV-cache management, batching, routing, speculative decoding — and of the frameworks the team works in (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM)
  • Enough technical judgment to review someone else's benchmark and find the flaw in the methodology, not just in the conclusion
  • Python strong enough to read and review your team's code
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical concepts to diverse audiences, from engineers to executives, including in front of enterprise customers under pressure
  • Genuine tolerance for operational work: documentation, process design, reporting, and the follow-through that makes them stick
  • Comfort operating with ambiguity across distributed teams and timezones, and a bias toward writing things down

It would be an added bonus if you have:

  • References from both former managers and former direct reports
  • Experience scaling a team through rapid growth (5 → 15+) without losing delivery quality
  • Prior experience in a customer-facing technical function at a cloud, inference, or AI infrastructure provider
  • Experience defining process and documentation for a team that had none
  • Hands-on background running LLMs in production and debugging inference workloads at the framework level
  • Work with multimodal AI models (vision-language, speech)
  • Proficiency with DevOps tooling (Docker, Kubernetes) and infrastructure-as-code

Preferred technical stack:

  • Programming languages: Python
  • ML frameworks and libraries: vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, SGLang, Transformers, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs
  • MLOps and DevOps tools: Kubernetes (K8s), Docker, Git
  • Cloud platforms: AWS (SageMaker, Bedrock), GCP (Vertex AI), Azure (Azure ML)

Pay Transparency

We offer competitive compensation and benefits packages. Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, the level at which the candidate is hired, and geographic location, consistent with applicable law.

Base Compensation Range
$228,000—$285,000 USD

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.
