raw.description:
Prosper Health is on a mission to make life happier and healthier for autistic and neurodivergent adults.

Despite autism diagnoses increasing more than 5x in the past 25 years, autistic adults have been systematically overlooked. This has led to extremely poor outcomes, including high rates of co-occurring mental health conditions and a lower life expectancy. Prosper is here to change that.

We deliver specialized mental health services for autistic adults, covered by insurance. We've helped tens of thousands of people receive an autism diagnosis for the first time, work with neurodivergent-affirming therapists, and find belonging through community. Our outcomes meaningfully outperform traditional care for autistic adults, with substantially greater improvements in mood, anxiety, and quality of life.

Prosper is growing 3x year over year and are at mid-double-digit millions in run-rate revenue, with thousands of active clients and 400+ clinicians. We're a high-ownership, mission-driven team, building something that has never existed for autistic and neurodivergent adults.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Strategy & Operations Lead to build and run the people systems that will support Prosper as we grow from approximately 800 to 1,500+ clinicians.

This is an operating role for someone who excels at turning ambiguous, high-complexity problems into simple, reliable systems. You’ll own the clinician journey from signed offer through start, compensation and benefits strategy, clinical organization design and talent development, People Ops service delivery, and core people systems for our HQ team.

You’ll be accountable for outcomes including signed-offer-to-start conversion, clinician total-rewards satisfaction, People Ops service levels, and HQ engagement and retention. You’ll also partner with Provider Operations on early clinician retention.

You do not need to arrive as a career HR leader. We’re open to exceptional operators from consulting, investment banking, business operations, strategy and operations, general management, or similar backgrounds. What matters most is your ability to learn quickly, exercise sound judgment, and own consequential work from diagnosis through execution.

You’ll initially receive support on complex employee-relations, compliance, and termination decisions. As you build domain expertise and demonstrate judgment, your ownership will expand.

You Will

  • Own clinician onboarding success: Lead the clinician journey from signed offer through start, building scalable processes that improve conversion, day-one readiness, learning and development, and early retention..
  • Own compensation and benefits strategy: Develop compensation frameworks, conduct market benchmarking, lead plan design and renewals, oversee implementation, and communicate total rewards clearly to employees.
  • Shape the clinical organization: Partner with clinical leadership on role definitions, leveling, career pathways, talent development, and the effectiveness of clinician learning and development.
  • Build scalable People Operations system: Manage accommodations, complaints, escalations, investigations, and terminations with clear service levels, escalation paths, and legally defensible documentation. Design simple, reliable workflows with clear ownership, handoffs, controls, documentation, and escalation paths that can support 1,500+ clinicians.
  • Build HQ people systems: Partner directly with the CEO on HQ onboarding, performance management, structured feedback, engagement, retention, and leveling frameworks. Create playbooks, templates, decision tools, and guidance that help managers navigate people decisions earlier and more consistently.
  • Lead the People Operations team: Manage and develop the existing team, ensuring recurring work is accurate, timely, visible, and continuously improving.

About You

  • You have approximately 5-7 years of experience, ideally including:
    • 3-4 years in consulting or investment banking, followed by 2-3 years in a strategic operating role at an early- to mid-stage startup, such as Business Operations, Strategy and Operations, General Management, Chief of Staff, or Clinical or Provider Operations.
  • You have owned consequential, cross-functional work from problem definition through implementation and measurable results.
  • You are comfortable moving between strategic questions—such as compensation frameworks and organization design—and hands-on operational execution.
  • You can work confidently with operational data, build useful models or trackers, detect issues, and translate analysis into decisions.
  • You communicate clearly and can bring structure to sensitive or ambiguous situations.
  • You have experience managing, coaching, or developing others, either directly or through cross-functional leadership.

Prior healthcare or people operations experience is not required. Exposure to a distributed, regulated, marketplace, or high-volume workforce is helpful but not necessary.

How You Operate

  • High ownership: You own consequential work end-to-end, create visibility, follow through on details, and escalate risks before they become problems.
  • First-principles problem-solving: You structure ambiguous problems, test assumptions, identify the key driver, and build solutions for the actual context rather than copying a generic playbook.
  • Builds for scale: You design simple systems with clear handoffs, controls, edge cases, and a path from the first version to significantly higher volume.
  • Data proficiency: You manipulate operational data, build useful models and trackers, identify issues, and translate analysis into decisions.
  • Learning agility: You enter unfamiliar domains quickly, identify what must be learned, seek expert input intelligently, and improve your judgment through feedback.
  • Practical judgment and communication: You balance speed, empathy, consistency, confidentiality, and risk; explain decisions clearly; and know when not to act alone.

What Success Looks Like

  • We understand why clinicians drop off between signing and starting, address the highest-impact causes, and improve signed-offer-to-start conversion.
  • Clinicians understand and value their compensation and benefits, reflected in stronger total-rewards satisfaction and lower regrettable attrition attributable to compensation or benefits.
  • Clinical roles, levels, and career pathways are clear, and learning and development programs measurably prepare clinicians to succeed.
  • Accommodations, complaints and escalations are acknowledged, investigated, documented, and resolved within clear service levels.
  • People Operations workflows remain reliable as clinician volume and organizational complexity increase while the People Operations team operates with strong prioritization, accuracy, visibility, and follow-through.

More about Prosper Health

  • Our culture is a unique mix of thoughtfulness, kindess, and high-performance. We set ambitious goals and hold ourselves accountable to achieving them.
  • We always ensure that we integrate perspectives from experts in our space, including clinicians and autistic self-advocates.
  • Our team members come from places such as Bain, McKinsey, BCG, FirstHand Health, Rula, SeatGeek, Benchling, and schools like Harvard, MIT, Stanford, Yale, Penn, Dartmouth, Northwestern, Vanderbilt, and more.
  • Here are a few of our favorite operating principles:
    • Clients first - Our job is to solve real problems for our clients. Choose what makes life better for the client, even if it’s harder for us. Never lose sight of the person on the other side.
    • Find a Way - We use ingenuity, scrappiness, and determination to bend the world to accomplish our goals. We’re resourceful and do more with less.
    • Raise the Bar - We grow deliberately, by asking how things can improve and by giving and seeking feedback. We insist on the highest standards and keep pushing them higher.
    • Be a Good Person - Be kind, be honest, and make it fun to work here. Tell the truth even when it’s uncomfortable. Treat people with respect and go out of your way to do nice things for your teammates.

About Megaport

We’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.

Our Team Culture

We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here – collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do.
We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

The Role

Reporting to the Regional Manager of Customer Success - West, the Customer Success Manager (CSM) will act as the main point of contact and interface with existing customers. This individual will have a core focus on post-sale relationships, with a main focus on upselling/cross-selling, including enablement, service performance, renewals, and supporting the overall customer experience.

They’ll be accountable for driving both incremental sales and retaining existing revenue by proactively reaching out to customers and introducing them to new product enhancements, service developments, pricing initiatives and other benefits of the Megaport proposition.

The position will sit within the wider Integrated Accounts Team, working closely alongside a Direct Sales Executive and Solutions Architect in the Pacific Northwest region. The CSM plays an integral role on the team, and ultimately, they’ll be responsible for providing ongoing commercial interaction for a designated customer base, aiming to expand, retain, and develop increased value from this nominated account list.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • As part of the Integrated Account Team, this role will collaborate with Direct Sales Executives and Solution Architects to drive, grow and retain targeted revenue from our existing customers, focusing on supporting the overall customer experience.

  • Proactively drive the renewal process across a wide base of customers and Increase long-term revenue potential by converting customers on month-to-month to term subscriptions at renewal.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to existing customers, focusing on initial onboarding and enablement, to ensure quick time to value as well as providing information about Megaport enhancements, new products and ecosystem partners.

  • Be responsible for proactive, sequenced outreach communications across a large base of customers driving further adoption, solution awareness and opportunities to engage with Megaport and our partner community.

  • Champion customers throughout their entire customer journey, including facilitating the resolution of customer-related issues and concerns from a Commercial and Sales standpoint, and understanding how we can add more value.

  • Nurture the nominated customer base, identifying key targets and operating an engagement strategy, based on opportunity and the customer vertical market or needs

  • Report on and analyze customer experience by understanding customer needs, and communicating trends to the wider Megaport team. Report growth opportunities through pipeline updates with SFDC updates.

  • Maintain in-depth knowledge of Megaport products and solutions and be able to propose and demonstrate these to the customers, whilst being aware of rival services or products. Maintain and share a value add opinion on Megaport and where we fit in the customer's ecosystem.

  • Review with management to understand key objectives and execute tasks that are aligned with the goals of the business; which will flex per the business focus or plans.

  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing teams on campaigns and strategies for revenue growth.

  • Acting as a subject matter expert you will evaluate customer feedback and make recommendations to continually align and improve processes that provide visibility and an understanding and measurement of business performance against targets.

  • Collaborate with other departmental teams (Finance, Operations, etc.) in helping to resolve challenges impacting the customer’s service experience.

What We Are Looking For

  • 3+ years experience within the Enterprise software market or Internet/Telecommunications industries.

  • 3+ years experience in an Account Management or Customer Success role.

  • Proven ability to work in a fast-paced technical environment, with multiple tasks or goals.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, as well as the ability to collaborate and work effectively across internal and external organisations.

  • Demonstrable ability to identify customer needs, appreciate and understand the customers’ service issues, or “pain points”, and present a suitable solution.

  • Ability to deliver revenue results and operate in a consultative-based selling approach.

  • Ability to work with the wider Megaport teams to focus on revenue generation and results.

  • Maintain records, reports and data as per the Megaport models, with a focus on revenue retention from the existing agreed customer list.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills are a must, as well as the ability to work effectively across internal and external organisations.

  • Experience in proposing or deploying cloud and virtualised compute solutions in enterprise customer environments is highly desired.

What We Offer

  • Flexible working environments

  • Birthday Leave

  • Generous study and training allowance + 5 days paid study leave

  • Creative, fun, and contemporary workspaces

  • Motivated team of industry experts and new talent

  • Celebrated success with ‘Legend’ and ‘Kudos’ Awards

  • Health and wellness program

If you have any questions, please reach out to Megaport's Talent Acquisition Team at
NOTE: All Megaport business correspondence is conducted via our business email accounts (@megaport.com). If you have any concerns, please reach out to Megaport's careers team directly and we will verify the legitimacy of any communication. Megaport will not ask you to create an account via Microsoft teams, and does not associate with any email accounts under "@megaportau.com".
All applications will be treated in confidence.

Please see Part 5 of our Privacy Policy for more details on this and how to contact Megaport's data protection officer if you have any further privacy-related questions. Project Manager / PMO – ERP Transformation Program (Oracle Fusion Cloud)

Reporting directly to the IT Program Director, this role serves as operational support for leadership. The individual will be responsible for maintaining a cohesive, cross-functional overview of the ERP/EPM transformation program (SAP ECC / BFC / Anaplan to Oracle Fusion Cloud), including work progress, capacity, key metrics, and defects. The role involves aggregating, verifying, and translating data provided by Scrum Masters and Stream Leads into decision-making materials for governance bodies.

Scope of Duties:

  • Ongoing progress tracking: Consolidating statuses across various streams (milestones, deliverables, dependencies), maintaining the program schedule and resource workload plan, and flagging variances.

  • Capacity planning: Building and maintaining the capacity plan: forecasted workload per stream, availability of IT teams, business units, and the integrator, as well as anticipating peak operational periods (testing, cutover). Monitoring actual utilization against the plan.

  • KPIs and reporting: Defining and evolving executive metrics, preparing dashboards, and creating materials for status committees and governance boards.

  • Defect management: Maintaining a consolidated view of defects in JIRA: triage, prioritization, assignment to streams, and monitoring metrics (volume, severity, age of tickets) along with phase exit criteria.

  • Risks and alerts: Maintaining the program risk register, formalizing action plans, and monitoring their execution.

Requirements:

  • Proven experience in the operational delivery of IT programs or in a PMO role, preferably within the ERP domain (Oracle Fusion Cloud is a strong plus).

  • Strong understanding of ERP testing cycles (SIT, UAT, cutover testing) and experience in coordinating testing campaigns across multi-team environments: consolidating progress, monitoring execution and efficacy metrics, and tracking phase exit criteria.

  • Hands-on experience in building and managing capacity/workload plans.

  • Proven ability to define KPIs, build reports, and prepare presentation decks for governance meetings.

  • Advanced proficiency in JIRA and Microsoft Excel; working knowledge of Power BI is highly desirable.

  • Strong risk management capabilities, excellent analytical and synthesis skills, and high autonomy.

About the Role:

We'rebuilding the systems that turn one of the world's largest scientific corpora intoresearchintelligence. That meansproductionNLP pipelines running over millions of journal articles, extracting entities, classifications, claim tuples, and summariesoptimizedfor use by downstream agentic applications.We'relooking for a senior data scientist to owndomain-specificcontentmodeling work end to end, from the eval set through the pipeline stage that ships it.

You'lljoin a small, senior team where data scientists own their models in production.You'llwrite the code, own the evaluations, ship the changes, and stay accountable for the outcomes. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to see their models through to real usersin a rapidly evolving market.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Design and build NLP enrichment pipelines that extract entities, classifications, claims, and summaries from scientificfull-textat scale.

  • Compare NLP approaches to extraction and enrichment against LLM-basedapproaches, andpick the right tool for each task. That means putting traditional NLP (NER, sequence labeling, classification), embedding-based retrieval, LLM prompting, and fine-tuned smaller models on the same table, and defending each choice with evaluation, cost, and operational tradeoffs. This is a core part of the job, not an occasional exercise.

  • Own evaluation. Build the golden setsin consultation with SMEs and vendors, choose the metrics, and make productive tradeoffs between speed, quality, and cost.

  • Contribute to agentic AI application work: tool-using systems that reason over the enriched corpus, where your NLP and evaluation background will shape how the agent grounds and defends its answers.

  • Work directly with editors, product managers, and engineers. Bring the modeling perspective into productdecisions, andtranslate stakeholderpushbackinto concrete modeling work.

Required Qualifications:

  • Strong NLP background across modern (LLMs, transformers, embeddings, retrieval) and classical (NER, classification, sequence labeling) approaches.You'vebuilt evaluationsand learned from the results.

  • Cleanpython. You are comfortable in exploratory notebooks and production repositories, and an engineer taking over a modeling output from you has a good head start.

  • A habit of comparing approaches and choosing the right one for the task. You can defend "prompt a large LLM" and "train a small classifier on 2,000 labels" with equal seriousness, back the choice with an eval and a costestimate, andknow what to do when performance drifts.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working with scientific or scholarly text.

  • Familiarity with AWS (S3, Batch, Lambda, SageMaker) and Parquet or Iceberg data lake patterns.

  • Experience running LLMs underreal costand latency budgets in production.

  • Some exposure to agentic AI applications: tool use, multi-step reasoning, guardrails, and evaluation of trajectories rather than single-turn outputs.

Job Title: Senior Data Analyst

SUMMARY: The Senior Data Analyst is a key contributor within the Analytics and Insights department, responsible for transforming complex datasets into actionable insights that inform organizational strategy and decision-making. This position leads the design, development, and delivery of data analyses, reports, and visualizations that support both internal operations and CalMHSA's broader behavioral health mission. The Senior Data Analyst works independently and collaboratively across departments, serving as a subject matter expert on data interpretation, quality, and methodology. Strong written and oral communication skills are essential, as this role regularly presents findings and recommendations to stakeholders at all levels of the organization. raw.excerpt: Who We ArePindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions.
raw.description:
Who We Are

Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions. Powered by the Pindrop Intelligence Network, our unified trust platform helps enterprises answer three critical questions:

Is this identity synthetic? Detect AI-generated and manipulated voice and video.
Is this identity risky? Identify fraud, suspicious behavior, and other risk signals.
Is this identity known? Authenticate identities using voice, device, behavioral, and other signals.

Pindrop brings this intelligence together across purpose-built trust engines to help organizations make informed decisions in real time — protecting customers, workforce interactions, and emerging AI-driven interactions.

Pindrop protects billions of high-risk interactions for enterprises, including leading financial institutions, insurers, and healthcare organizations. Its technology is informed by more than 8 billion real-world interactions annually and protected by 300+ patents.

Recognized by TIME as one of the 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG.

What you’ll do

Depending on your level and domain expertise, as a Pindrop Research Scientist, you will drive core research initiatives, deliver reproducible experimental results, and help translate machine learning models into real-world product solutions. You may:

  • Conduct research to develop new functionalities and improve existing technologies across our core domains (Fraud, Voice/Speech, Video, Authentication, and Deepfake Detection).
  • Design, implement, and evaluate deep learning algorithms and ML models tailored to complex datasets.
  • Partner closely with research engineers and engineering teams to transition complex research prototypes into efficient, production-ready systems across cloud or edge environments.
  • Support targeted investigations by analyzing system behavior, identifying detection gaps, and recommending practical improvements for our customers.
  • Participate in cross-functional team meetings, contribute to regular research and code reviews, and publish patents and peer-reviewed papers in top conferences.

Who you are

  • You remain focused, persistent, and scientifically rigorous through multiple experimental iterations, navigating ambiguity in research data, quality, or shifting methodologies.
  • You seamlessly bridge the gap between research and engineering teams. You can explain complex AI/ML concepts with clarity to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • You take individual ownership of assigned research projects and workstreams, making sound technical decisions using available data, theory, and rigorous experimental evidence.
  • You follow through on your commitments, communicate research progress transparently, and maintain the highest standard of technical integrity, documentation, and model reproducibility.
  • You use machine learning frameworks effectively to design, train, and evaluate models, carefully validating outputs and applying sound judgment to balance experimentation speed with robustness, compliance, and model quality.

Your skill-set

Because this is a general pipeline for all levels, we welcome candidates with a variety of backgrounds. The qualifications we look for across our teams include:

  • Degree (Master’s or PhD) in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence) or equivalent industry research experience.
  • We hire across all levels—from early-career researchers (1-3 years) to highly tenured Senior/Principal Research Scientists (6+ years) focused on deep learning, computer vision, face recognition, generative AI, speech processing, or fraud modeling.
  • Strong programming proficiency in Python and hands-on mastery of modern machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Keras.
  • A proven track record of successful project delivery, publishing peer-reviewed research, or translating research findings into practical improvements (models, decision systems, or production recommendations).
  • Foundational or expert-level knowledge of biometrics, identity authentication, fraud patterns, audio/video pipelines, or consumer security concepts.

What’s in it for you

At Pindrop, research sits at the intersection of AI, voice, fraud, identity, and customer experience. You’ll turn real-world interaction data into insights that influence how our products evolve and how we help enterprises make better decisions.

  • Build expertise in an emerging category: Develop firsthand knowledge of voice intelligence, fraud prevention, authentication, and deepfake detection as these fields continue to evolve.
  • Work with real-world data at meaningful scale: Analyze complex calls, interactions, and behavioral patterns to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities that matter to customers.
  • Learn from experienced research and cross-functional teams: Partner with Research, Product, Engineering, Fraud Strategy, and Customer Experience leaders to understand how insights become better products and decisions.
  • Strengthen your research and analytical judgment: Develop your ability to identify patterns, evaluate evidence, ask sharper questions, and translate qualitative observations into clear recommendations.
  • See your work influence real outcomes: Your findings will help improve product quality, fraud detection, customer experiences, analyst performance, and the way Pindrop protects high-risk interactions.
  • Grow into a broader research professional: Build the communication, critical-thinking, problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills needed to take on increasing ownership and more complex research questions.

For more senior research roles, you will shift your emphasis toward owning the research agenda, shaping product and business strategy, influencing executive decisions, mentoring others, and defining how Pindrop creates differentiated insight.

What we offer

As a part of Pindrop, you’ll have a direct impact on our growing list of products and the future of security in the voice-driven economy. We hire great people and take care of them. Here’s a snapshot of the benefits we offer:

  • Competitive compensation package, including RSUs (Restricted Stock Units) for all employees, so everyone shares in our long-term success.
  • Remote-first environment - giving you flexibility and autonomy in how you structure your day.
  • While we work flexibly, we prioritize meaningful in-person moments through regular team on-sites, company-wide events, and intentional gatherings that foster connection, collaboration, and shared success.
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Generous health and welfare plans to choose from - including one employer-paid “employee-only” plan!
  • Best-in-class Health Savings Account (HSA) employer contribution
  • Low-cost vision and dental plans for you and your family, providing comprehensive coverage and peace of mind.
  • Paid Parental Leave - Including birth, adoptive & foster parents
  • One year of diaper delivery for your newest addition to the family! It’s our way of welcoming new Pindroplets to the family!
  • Recurring monthly phone and internet allowance to help cover essential connectivity costs and support flexible work.
  • Enhanced fertility and GLP-1 benefits to support family-building journeys and personalized health needs.
  • Annual Learning & Development stipend to support your professional growth, skill-building, certifications, and continued education.

Not sure if this is you?

We want a diverse, global team, with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job sounds great, but you’re not sure if you qualify, apply anyway! We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time.

AI - A Transformative Force

At Pindrop, we view artificial intelligence as a transformative force that, when harnessed responsibly, can unlock unprecedented value for our customers, partners and society and enable and empower us to continue to deliver cutting-edge technology to combat fraud and unblur the lines between what it means to be human versus machine.

Pindrop may use AI tools to help prioritize job applications for human review. The AI tool may analyze your work experience and skills to assess fit for the role, but does not consider your name or contact details. Applications with the strongest match to job requirements are prioritized for human review; not all applications may be individually reviewed.

Pindrop is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Here at Pindrop, it is our mission to create and maintain a diverse and inclusive work environment. As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, disability, marital and/or veteran status.

raw.description:
Technical Operations Specialist


About Us
Property Leads is a fast-growing performance marketing company specializing in connecting motivated homeowners with real estate investors, with expanding operations across home services and other consumer verticals.

We're a lean, fast-moving startup that values ownership, resourcefulness, and results. We operate across multiple marketing channels, manage a growing network of partners, and move quickly to capitalize on new opportunities.

We don't believe in unnecessary bureaucracy or meetings for the sake of meetings. We believe in hiring smart, capable people who can solve problems, take initiative, and make things happen. If you thrive in a dynamic environment where priorities evolve and your work has an immediate impact, you'll fit right in.

About the Role
We're looking for a technically savvy, highly organized operations generalist to help manage the day-to-day technical and operational needs of our growing business.

This is a hands-on role at the intersection of technical operations, partner tech operations, campaign execution, creative compliance, and process improvement. You'll work closely with our affiliate team, internal stakeholders, and external partners to ensure campaigns launch smoothly, technical integrations function properly, and operational workflows run efficiently.

You'll be responsible for everything from partner onboarding and technical troubleshooting to coordinating creative approvals, managing campaign configurations, and identifying opportunities to streamline processes.

We're not looking for someone who needs a rigid job description or constant direction. We're looking for someone who can juggle multiple priorities, recognize what needs attention, take ownership, and figure out how to get things done.

This is an operations-first role that requires strong technical aptitude, not a traditional software engineering position.

Key Responsibilities
1. Partner & Campaign Operations

  • Own the operational and technical setup of new partners, campaigns, and traffic sources, ensuring launches are accurate, timely, and seamless.
  • Work closely with the affiliate team and external partners to coordinate integrations, troubleshoot issues, and resolve technical or operational roadblocks.
  • Manage campaign configurations, tracking implementations, payout updates, and other technical adjustments across our platforms.
  • Support the implementation and maintenance of various partner integrations, lead delivery systems, and marketing technologies.
  • Serve as a reliable point of contact for operational and technical requests, communicating clearly and keeping projects moving without unnecessary delays.

2. Creative Approvals & Workflow Management

  • Manage high-volume creative approval workflows, coordinating between external partners, clients, and internal teams.
  • Track submissions, feedback, revisions, and approvals to ensure timely turnaround and accurate documentation.
  • Maintain organized records and processes to ensure campaigns meet internal requirements and client expectations.
  • Identify bottlenecks and develop more efficient systems for managing recurring approvals and operational requests.

3. Technical Troubleshooting & Support

  • Investigate and resolve tracking discrepancies, integration issues, data inconsistencies, and other technical challenges.
  • Perform quality assurance checks on partner setups, campaign launches, tracking, and lead delivery processes.
  • Collaborate with internal technical resources when necessary, while independently resolving issues within your scope.
  • Proactively monitor workflows and identify potential problems before they impact campaign performance or partner relationships.

4. Process Improvement & Automation

  • Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve operational workflows across teams.
  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate troubleshooting, streamline repetitive tasks, improve documentation, and increase overall efficiency.
  • Build and maintain organized processes that can scale as the company grows.
  • Help develop SOPs, internal resources, and reporting systems that reduce friction and improve execution.
  • Adapt quickly as new partnerships, channels, tools, and business priorities emerge.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience in technical operations, marketing operations, affiliate operations, ad operations, or a similarly technical and execution-focused role.
  • Strong technical aptitude and the ability to learn new platforms, troubleshoot integrations, and navigate unfamiliar systems independently.
  • Familiarity with performance marketing technologies, tracking platforms, APIs, pixels, or lead management systems is highly desirable.
  • Exceptional organizational skills and the ability to manage a high volume of requests, projects, and competing priorities without losing attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience using AI tools to improve productivity, solve problems, and optimize workflows. We want someone who actively explores how technology can make them more effective.
  • A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset. You don't wait for someone to tell you there's a problem or exactly how to solve it.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced startup environment where priorities can shift quickly and responsibilities aren't always neatly defined.
  • Strong sense of accountability and follow-through. If you own something, you see it through to completion.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal oversight while knowing when to communicate, collaborate, or escalate.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with affiliate tracking platforms such as TUNE, Everflow, or similar systems.
  • Familiarity with lead generation, ping/post integrations, call tracking, or performance marketing campaign setups.
  • Experience with workflow automation tools, CRM systems, or project management platforms.
  • Experience working directly with affiliate publishers, advertisers, or external marketing partners.
  • Familiarity with data analysis, reporting, or basic API troubleshooting.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 90 days, success means:

  • Seamless partner launches: New partners, campaigns, and integrations are set up accurately and efficiently, with minimal delays or unnecessary back-and-forth.
  • Operational ownership: The affiliate team and external partners can rely on you to handle technical requests, troubleshoot issues, and keep workflows moving without constant follow-up.
  • Efficient creative approvals: High-volume approval processes are organized, responsive, and consistently managed.
  • Proactive problem-solving: You're identifying issues, anticipating needs, and resolving operational bottlenecks before they become larger problems.
  • Smarter processes: You've identified and implemented meaningful improvements, including AI-powered efficiencies and automation where appropriate.
  • Independence and adaptability: You've demonstrated that you can manage competing priorities, pivot quickly, and take ownership of new challenges with minimal oversight.

The Bottom Line
We're looking for someone who is equal parts technical, operational, and resourceful. Someone who can manage the details, solve problems, keep people aligned, and make sure things get done. This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in a growing company, take ownership of important processes, and help build the operational infrastructure that supports our next stage of growth.

Salary: $2,500 – $3,500 / month

We're building the future of Hybrid Healthcare and it starts with people like you.

Fresh Clinics empowers nurses and doctors to run thriving, compliant, and modern healthcare practices through our native iOS App, medical oversight, and human support behind them.

We're Australian founded, and in 7 years grown to 170+ Freshie's and support +2000 clinicians across Australia, and now scaling fast in the USA; all whilst staying true to what matters most: building safe, sustainable hybrid healthcare.

We're proud finalists in Deloitte’s Tech Fast 50 three years in a row and our culture is as bold as our mission: We work smart, hustle hard, stay humble, and lead with kindness.

If you’re looking for a workplace that celebrates our people, drives real-world impact, and champions innovation - welcome home.

About the role

We're looking for experienced Nurse Practitioners with Aesthetic experience & full time availability to join our telehealth team as independent contractors. This is flexible, on-demand work that suits you if you want autonomy, and the ability to log on and off to suit your schedule.

Here's what you'll be doing:

You'll conduct real-time video consultations with patients via the Fresh platform, assess their suitability for cosmetic injectable treatments, and where clinically appropriate and within your endorsed scope of practice, prescribe Schedule 4 medicines and issue treatment authorisations for Fresh Clinic treating nurses.

The core work centres on three things: thorough patient consultation and medical assessment, informed consent and collaborative treatment planning, and clinical documentation maintained to the highest standard. You'll work across the full spectrum of non-surgical aesthetics: botulinum toxin, dermal fillers, bio-stimulators, skin boosters, PDO threads, PRP treatments, and comprehensive facial rejuvenation planning.

What you'll do

Patient Assessment & Tele-consultation

  • Video Consultations: Conduct mandatory real-time video consultations before issuing any prescription or authorisation.
  • Comprehensive Screening: Verify patient identity, review full health histories, and assess contraindications or previous treatments.
  • Psychological Suitability: Administer validated screening tools (including BDD screening) for every patient to ensure appropriateness for treatment.

Clinical Decision-Making & Collaboration

  • Nurse Collaboration: Partner directly with treating nurses on clinical decision-making and holistic treatment planning.
  • Treatment Authorisations: Exercise professional judgment to approve, modify, or decline treatment plans, issuing authorisations with specific conditions or limits via the Fresh platform.

Governance, Documentation & Quality Assurance

  • Contemporaneous Documentation: Maintain thorough records for all consultations—including declined treatments—and capture informed consent using app templates.
  • Safety & Escalation: Escalate clinical concerns and adverse events promptly through Fresh's governance channels.
  • Audit & Peer Review: Actively participate in clinical audits, case reviews, and peer review processes to maintain high standards of care.

The practical things:

  • You're remote and mobile-first. You nominate your own availability and log on to accept consultation requests
  • We are looking for practitioners with full time availability, to be rostered, with our peak demand being Tuesday to Saturday, 9am to 6pm; we will also have shifts available Monday, Tuesday, and Sundays
  • You'll use the Fresh App on a supported iOS device from a private location with stable internet and good audio/video

We'd love you to have

The Essentials:

  • Current Ahpra registration as a Nurse Practitioner with no conditions, undertakings, or restrictions
  • Endorsement to prescribe Schedule 4 medicines within your scope of practice
  • Demonstrated experience in cosmetic and aesthetic medicine
  • Sound working knowledge of Ahpra's non-surgical cosmetic procedures and telehealth guidelines, and the NMBA Nurse Practitioner Standards for Practice
  • Current professional indemnity insurance in your own name, meeting NMBA standards and covering telehealth consultation, prescribing, and cosmetic practice, plus run-off cover
  • Current CPR certification and competence in recognising and managing cosmetic injectable complications
  • Ability to consult independently and make sound clinical decisions in a remote setting
  • Reliable supported iOS device, stable internet, and a private consultation space
  • National police check
  • An Australian Business Number and capacity to invoice as an independent contractor

Great extras:

  • Experience both performing cosmetic injectable treatments and overseeing or authorising them in a clinic or telehealth setting
  • Familiarity with cosmetic injectable products, treatment protocols, and complication management
  • Availability throughout the week and especially during peak windows (Tuesday–Saturday)
  • Comfort working across a digital platform with minimal administrative support
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to build rapport quickly in telehealth
  • Experience contributing to clinical governance, audit, or committee work

What You Need to Know
You are the prescriber. Every authorisation you issue carries your professional and legal responsibility. Fresh Clinics provides the platform, protocols, and governance support that make that responsibility manageable—but we don't assume it on your behalf. You'll retain full responsibility for your prescribing and clinical decisions, and you'll practise within your individual endorsed scope of practice and in compliance with all AHPRA guidelines and state/territory health legislation.

Why Fresh

  • We're disrupting how hybrid healthcare is delivered
  • We're remote-first and outcomes focused
  • We're profitable and focused on building a long-term sustainable growth model
  • Our Freshie's love working here (+65eNPS globally)

OurValues

Everyone who works with Fresh Clinics—whether employed or contracted—is expected to embody our core values.

💡 Work Smart — We focus our energy on what matters most and always look for better ways to do things.

💪 Hustle Hard — We're resourceful, resilient, and driven to create impact that lasts.

💚 Be Kind — We lead with empathy and respect, always.

🙏 Stay Humble — We listen, learn, and celebrate others' wins as much as our own.

⏳ Wait for the Second Marshmallow — We play the long game, knowing meaningful results take time and patience.

🔗 Discover more here

Are you ready?

Apply now and tell us why you could be our next Freshie.

Your Perspective Matters

At Fresh, we believe that a diverse team is an innovative team. We are focused on creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences feel they belong and can thrive.

We strongly encourage you to apply, even if your past experience doesn’t perfectly align with every qualification listed. Your unique skills and passion could be just what we’re looking for, for this role or another.

raw.description:
About AgelessRx

AgelessRx is a first-of-its-kind, longevity-focused telehealth platform with an e-commerce component. Our mission is to collectively give people millions of extra healthy years, so everyone can enjoy more of what they love in a world where people are empowered to live as long as they want. We believe aging should no longer be treated as a dreadful inevitability, but instead, as a puzzle that can be solved, a fight that can be fought – just as a disease with a cure. Through our free-to-use platform, we offer trusted, data-driven longevity solutions and scientifically backed prescription therapies to help safely lower the risk of age-related diseases.

About the role

AgelessRx's Manager of Lifecycle Marketing is responsible for the development and implementation of comprehensive end-to-end lifecycle marketing strategies to maximize customer lifetime value by optimizing the customer journey.

Working closely with a variety of teams, including the Product, Engineering, Customer Experience, and Data & Analytics, they will develop lifecycle marketing strategies and campaigns across various channels that will improve customer engagement and retention. The Manager of Lifecycle Marketing will report findings to key stakeholders to assist leadership in making data-driven decisions by analyzing campaign performance to identify areas of improvement and communicate meaningful insights. The Manager of Lifecycle Marketing will be responsible for delivering outcomes on CRM, leading to growth and retention.

What you'll do

Strategy Development

  • Own and optimize lifecycle marketing strategies, including customer onboarding, engagement, retention, and reactivation across various channels such as email, SMS, customer portal, and other relevant touch points to deliver outcomes.
  • Oversee and execute end-to-end email marketing execution from briefing, copywriting, graphics, competitor analysis, audience list pull, email build, and deployment to email performance and metrics reporting.
  • Understand the brand positioning, writing punchy, on-brand email copy for timely execution.
  • Assist marketing leaders in developing a roadmap for customer segmentation, messaging, campaign management, and triggered communications throughout the customer lifecycle.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align lifecycle marketing initiatives with overall business objectives.
  • Oversee email marketing agency to develop, implement, and monitor triggered email journeys and promotional campaigns.
  • Work closely with marketing team members including copywriters, graphic designers, and cross-functional teams to support expedited implementation of email journeys.
  • Maintain an understanding of industry trends and best practices in CRM, loyalty, and e-commerce, and develop innovative strategies and campaigns to enhance customer experiences and increase revenue.
  • Work closely with Customer Experience team to ensure a best-in-class patient experience, creating and optimizing automated email journeys to increase conversions and drive customer retention.
  • Oversee CRM from a data-driven perspective, analyzing conversions, analytics, retention, optimizations, and testing opportunities.
  • Create and maintain a testing roadmap across key lifecycle elements (subject lines, CTAs, creative, messaging, segments, send times, etc.) and turn results into actionable insights

Campaign Management

  • Develop, implement, and monitor multichannel marketing campaigns across a range of customer lifecycle stages, including retention, nurture, prospect, and lead generation.
  • Implement strategies to increase customer retention and foster loyalty, such as loyalty programs, segmented communication strategies, and reward programs for repeat purchases.
  • Analyze areas of opportunity for strategic optimizations that will increase revenue, improve conversions, boost retention, and increase sales, while supporting the overall brand experience
  • Execute campaigns directly within Braze, owning the end-to-end setup of journeys, segments, triggers, and reporting with minimal engineering support.

Data Analysis and Insights

  • Provide analysis of key metrics as part of the evaluation, optimization, and benchmarking process, in partnership with cross-functional teams; generate and communicate meaningful insights to key stakeholders in order to assist them in making more informed and data-driven decisions.
  • Analyze customer data to identify opportunities for personalization, behavioral targeting, and interventions tailored to specific lifecycle stages.
  • Have a data-driven mindset to optimize underperforming and reiterate optimized email journeys to continuously improve performance across various lifecycle stages.

Qualifications

  • 4 years of experience in marketing with a focus on lifecycle marketing (ideally through transformation, growth or rebuild)
  • Experience with marketing automation platforms, CRM systems, email marketing tools, and analytics software to interpret results. Preferably experience with Braze.
  • Extremely organized with an ability to prioritize and self-manage
  • Demonstrated success in loyalty strategies, retention, and sales growth
  • Experience developing efficient and effective end-to-end journey/campaign strategies
  • Familiarity with the health tech industry and knowledge of best practices and emerging trends in lifecycle marketing
  • Hypothesis-led and data-driven in all marketing intent. Comfort with numbers and analytics required.
  • Strong product skills, and the ability to understand and contribute to cross-functional discussion and planning around efforts to increase activation, reduce churn and improve conversion

raw.excerpt: About AgelessRx AgelessRx is a first-of-its-kind, longevity-focused telehealth platform with an e-commerce component.
raw.description:
About AgelessRx

AgelessRx is a first-of-its-kind, longevity-focused telehealth platform with an e-commerce component. Our mission is to collectively give people millions of extra healthy years, so everyone can enjoy more of what they love in a world where people are empowered to live as long as they want. We believe aging should no longer be treated as a dreadful inevitability, but instead, as a puzzle that can be solved, a fight that can be fought – just as a disease with a cure. Through our free-to-use platform, we offer trusted, data-driven longevity solutions and scientifically backed prescription therapies to help safely lower the risk of age-related diseases.

About the role

AgelessRx is seeking a hands-on, highly analytical Vice President of Growth & Marketing to lead and operationalize our marketing organization. This is not a traditional brand-marketing or executive-oversight role. We are looking for a performance-oriented operator who has personally been deep in growth channels, experimentation, funnels, CAC/LTV economics, and scaling DTC businesses - and who now knows how to build systems and teams that consistently produce results.

This person will own the marketing operating layer across paid acquisition, lifecycle marketing, retention, analytics, experimentation, and brand. They will be responsible for aligning priorities across functions, improving organizational execution, managing performance, and ensuring the marketing organization operates as a cohesive system rather than a collection of disconnected channels.

The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with strong execution instincts. They know how to build teams, create accountability, identify blind spots, prioritize aggressively, and push growth forward through disciplined experimentation and operational excellence.

What you'll do

Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Hire, develop, coach, performance-manage, and hold accountable marketing team members, channel owners, agencies, vendors, and external partners.
  • Brings their own ideas, tactics, and growth initiatives to the table - and has the credibility and track record to push the team to implement them. This is not a role that simply manages what others propose.
  • Ensure AgelessRx’s value proposition is consistently reflected across campaigns, landing pages, content, lifecycle communications, and customer touchpoints.
  • Partner with brand, content, digital marketing, product, clinical, legal, compliance, finance, and executive teams to align marketing execution with business goals, customer experience, and healthcare standards.
  • Serve as the senior marketing leader responsible for connecting team-level execution to company-level priorities.
  • Ensure the marketing organization has the right people, systems, and decision-making structures to scale effectively.

Marketing Strategy & Growth Priorities

  • Own the marketing function across paid media, lifecycle marketing, brand, growth analytics, experimentation, and acquisition/retention channels.
  • Set growth priorities, budget guardrails, CAC/LTV expectations, channel-level targets, and ROI standards.
  • Determine which channels, audiences, campaigns, and initiatives should be scaled, tested, optimized, or deprioritized.
  • Partner with Finance to maintain the growth financial model, including spend levels, marginal ROI, CAC, LTV, payback, and channel-level scaling decisions.
  • Translate channel performance, experiment results, growth priorities, and marketing investment decisions into clear business implications for the executive team.

Execution, Operating Rhythm & Accountability

  • Lead the marketing team day to day, ensuring paid media, lifecycle, brand, analytics, and experimentation work together as an integrated system.
  • Own the team’s operating rhythm, including performance reviews, prioritization meetings, decision forums, reporting cadence, follow-through, and accountability mechanisms.
  • Improve execution quality by spotting blind spots, resolving dependencies, removing blockers, and keeping the team focused on the highest-impact work.
  • Redirect, sharpen, escalate, or change the approach when experiments, campaigns, channels, or team workflows are not producing results.
  • Build a proactive, high-accountability culture that enables high-agency team members without adding unnecessary process or bureaucracy.
  • Owns go-to-market for new product launches - funnel architecture, positioning, offer structure, and the experiment roadmap for each new product line entering the market."

Experimentation, Analytics & Performance Management

  • Hold accountability for the experimentation roadmap’s business impact, even if the Growth PMM owns day-to-day test coordination.
  • Ensure every major experiment has a clear hypothesis, owner, timeline, success metric, sample size, and decision rule.
  • Establish and manage reporting frameworks across CAC, LTV, payback, conversion, retention, channel efficiency, and ROI.
  • Periodically audit paid media and growth channels at a structural level, ensuring account architecture, bidding strategy, measurement, reporting, and optimization practices are sound.
  • Reallocate budget, people, and attention based on performance data, cutting low-return efforts and investing in KPI-backed growth opportunities.

What success looks like

  • At 45 Days: The marketing team has a clear operating rhythm, channel owners and agencies are being held to weekly commitments, and performance reporting is trusted and actionable without CEO involvement.
  • At 90 Days: Growth metrics are improving across CAC, LTV, and funnel conversion. The experimentation engine is compounding. The team is performing above where it was before this person arrived — individually and collectively.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in growth, performance, or digital marketing, with significant experience leading high-performing marketing organizations in fast-paced, high-growth environments.
  • Proven track record of scaling customer acquisition and retention programs while maintaining efficient CAC/LTV economics.
  • Deep enough fluency across paid channels (Google, Meta, affiliates) to challenge channel owners credibly, and know when performance explanations don't add up — without personally running campaigns day-to-day.
  • Demonstrated experience building and managing high-velocity experimentation programs focused on measurable business impact.
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skillset with the ability to interpret complex performance data and translate insights into actionable strategies.
  • Experience building and managing marketing financial models, forecasting growth performance, and making data-driven budget allocation decisions.
  • Strong understanding of attribution, analytics, funnel optimization, and marketing measurement frameworks.
  • Experience leading and developing cross-functional teams, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and organizational design.

raw.description:
At Veracity, we aim to be a different kind of insurance partner – one that is free from outside investors, venture capital, or the pressures of a corporate parent.

Ours is a culture of empowerment – one that believes in effort, results, and accountability. We believe that transparency fosters trust, trust fosters growth, and that growth drives innovation. Our commitment to rigorous evaluation and relentless execution lead to rapid evolution.

We answer only to the small business owners we serve, and this independence allows us to stay focused on what matters most: helping their businesses thrive by providing expert guidance and best-in-class insurance policies.

We’re growing fast and want you to be a part of it!

We're seeking a detail-oriented and technically proficient Atlassian System Administrator to join our team. This role owns and evolves the company's Atlassian Cloud platform – Jira Cloud, Confluence Cloud, Atlassian Guard/Access, and the broader Atlassian Cloud ecosystem – as the foundation for how teams across Veracity, Insurance Canopy, and InsCipher plan, track, and execute work.

This remote role serves as the organization's internal Atlassian Cloud expert, partnering with Engineering, Operations, Customer Support, Compliance, and business leaders to translate workflows into well-designed, scalable system solutions. The goal is to make the Atlassian Cloud platform a force multiplier for the organization – reducing manual work through automation, standardizing how teams operate, surfacing real-time visibility through dashboards, and enabling adjacent tools to integrate cleanly with Atlassian Cloud as the system of record.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end administration of the Atlassian Cloud stack – Jira Cloud (Software, Service Management, Work Management), Confluence Cloud, Atlassian Guard/Access, and connected marketplace apps – across a Cloud-only environment
  • Configure and maintain projects, boards, issue types, workflows, screens, custom fields, components, versions, and notification, permission, and security schemes within Jira Cloud
  • Manage user provisioning, groups, roles, product access, SSO/SCIM, and license allocation across the Atlassian Cloud organization
  • Maintain Confluence Cloud spaces, templates, page hierarchies, permissions, and space governance to support knowledge management at scale
  • Oversee Jira Service Management Cloud queues, request types, SLAs, customer portals, and approval flows to support internal and customer-facing service operations
  • Design, build, and maintain Jira Cloud Automation rules, Confluence Cloud automations, and cross-product workflows that reduce manual updates and handoffs – tracking quarterly reductions in manual effort as a core measure of impact
  • Build and maintain integrations between Atlassian Cloud and other business systems (Slack, Microsoft Teams, Office 365, Google Workspace, GitHub, DocuSign, Salesforce, and HRIS/ITSM tools) using native Cloud connectors, REST APIs, webhooks, and low-code platforms such as Zapier, Workato, or n8n
  • Evaluate, install, configure, and govern Atlassian Marketplace Cloud apps – managing app lifecycle, security review, and renewals across the stack
  • Design and maintain dashboards, JQL-based filters, and reporting that give teams and leadership real-time visibility into priorities, workload, risks, and blockers – without manual reporting overhead
  • Partner with departments to map current workflows, identify bottlenecks, and design repeatable Jira and Confluence processes – establishing standard operating rhythms and onboarding new teams quickly using approved templates and configurations

raw.description:
Why Pythian:

At Pythian, we are experts in strategic database and analytics services, driving digital transformation and operational excellence. Pythian, a multinational company, was founded in 1997 and started by ensuring the reliability and performance of mission-critical databases. We quickly earned a reputation for solving tough data challenges. We were there when the industry moved from on-premises to cloud environments, and as enterprises sought more from their data, we expanded our competencies to include advanced analytics.

Today, we empower organizations to embrace transformation and leverage advanced technologies, including AI, to stay competitive. We deliver innovative solutions that meet each client’s data goals and have built strong partnerships with Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, SAP, and Snowflake. The powerful combination of our extensive expertise in data and cloud and our ability to keep on top of the latest bleeding edge technologies make us the perfect partner to help mid and large-sized businesses transform to stay ahead in today’s rapidly changing digital economy.

Why you:

Pythian sits at the intersection of data engineering, AI production, and managed services — helping enterprises turn data complexity into competitive advantage. With three decades of deep managed services heritage and strategic partnerships across the leading cloud and database technology ecosystems, we are at the forefront of helping clients move from AI experimentation to AI in production.

We are looking for a polished, quota-carrying Sales Executive who is energized by the AI moment and knows how to help enterprise clients build the modern, well-managed data foundations that make production AI possible at scale. You are comfortable hunting new logos, converting inbound leads, and growing existing accounts. You bring credibility in conversations about Database Managed Services, Production AI, and cloud and database technologies — and you know how to co-sell effectively with OEM and hyperscaler partners to drive mutual value.

What Makes This Role Unique:

Pythian’s portfolio spans the full stack from data foundations to production AI — Production AI, Database Managed Services, AI Strategy & Automation, Data Migrations, Cloud Consulting, and Agentic AI solutions, supported by partnerships across Google Cloud, Oracle, AWS, Microsoft Azure, SAP, and the broader modern data ecosystem. This means you’re never selling a point solution; you’re building long-term, high-value partnerships with clients who want a trusted advisor to help them scale intelligently.

If you’re energized by the AI transformation happening across enterprise technology right now, know how to sell complex managed services, and want to represent a company with deep technical credibility and a growing AI practice — this role is built for you.

What you will be doing:

Territory & Pipeline

  • Build and execute a territory plan with a disciplined mix of new logo hunting, inbound conversion, and account expansion.
  • Maintain a robust, accurately forecasted pipeline in Salesforce; provide weekly pipeline reviews and revenue projections.
  • Develop targeted account strategies for key prospects in retail, manufacturing, logistics, financial services, and other enterprise verticals.
  • Identify and pursue net-new logos while deepening relationships and expanding wallet share within existing accounts.

AI & Data Services Sales

  • Lead discovery and solution conversations around Production AI, AI Strategy, Agentic AI, and AI Automation with enterprise buyers (CAIO, CDO, CTO, CIO).
  • Articulate how modern, well-managed data estates — across databases, cloud data platforms, and data migrations — are the critical scaffolding for scalable AI.
  • Sell the business case for Database Managed Services and DBA Support, connecting operational reliability to AI readiness and cost efficiency.
  • Help clients understand Pythian’s phased “Data Foundations to Production AI” journey and position appropriate entry points based on their maturity.

Partner & OEM Co-sell

  • Co-sell with hyperscaler and OEM field teams — including Google Cloud, Oracle — to drive joint pipeline and leverage partner co-sell programs, Marketplace motions, and funded assessment opportunities.
  • Navigate partner deal registration, funding programs, and co-sell qualification processes across multiple technology ecosystems to accelerate deal velocity and protect margin.
  • Build and maintain strong field relationships with partner account teams, knowing how to activate the right partner resources at the right stage of a deal.
  • Serve as the primary relationship owner for your accounts while leveraging Pythian’s delivery, solutions, and field CTO resources as needed.

Deal Execution & Internal Orchestration

  • Lead enterprise sales cycles end-to-end: discovery, business case development, proposal, negotiation, and close.
  • Act as the internal project manager for your deals — coordinating across Solutions Architecture, Delivery, Legal, and Finance to keep complex cycles moving, ensure scope integrity, and deliver proposals on time.
  • Know when and how to engage the right internal resources (Field CTO, practice leads, delivery SMEs) and manage those relationships to build credibility with prospects without over-committing delivery capacity.
  • Prepare and present compelling proposals, RFP responses, and executive-level business case materials.
  • Document client interactions, capture competitive intelligence, and share win/loss insights to continuously improve Pythian’s go-to-market.

Travel as required to attend client meetings, partner events, industry conferences, and Pythian’s annual sales kickoff.

What we need from you:

  • 6+ years of enterprise technology sales experience with a consistent record of meeting or exceeding quota.
  • Active experience selling Data & AI services — managed databases, cloud data platforms, AI strategy, or production AI implementations — to enterprise buyers.
  • Demonstrated ability to sell managed services: you know who to call, how to build the business case, and how to navigate procurement for recurring-revenue engagements.
  • Experience co-selling with hyperscaler or OEM field teams (Google Cloud, Oracle, AWS, Microsoft, or similar), including familiarity with partner programs, deal registration, and funded motions.
  • Strong internal project management instincts: proven ability to orchestrate cross-functional resources — solutions architects, delivery leads, legal, finance — across complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles without losing momentum or scope control.
  • A hunter’s instinct for new logos combined with the relationship acumen to grow and retain existing accounts.
  • Polished enterprise presence with the ability to engage confidently at VP and C-suite level across business and technical audiences.
  • Proficiency in Salesforce for pipeline management, forecasting, and account planning.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience selling within one or more of Pythian’s core technology ecosystems: Google Cloud (BigQuery, Vertex AI, Gemini) and/or Oracle (database, infrastructure), and also AWS, Microsoft Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, or SAP.
  • Familiarity with the modern data stack and cloud data platforms across multiple hyperscalers.
  • Comfort positioning AI solutions — Agentic AI, GenAI/RAG, MLOps, AI automation — to enterprise decision-makers.
  • Experience with Database Managed Services or Infrastructure Managed Services sales cycles and pricing models.
  • Background selling into $300M–$1B revenue companies in manufacturing, retail, logistics, finance, or healthcare verticals.
  • Relevant cloud, database, or AI certifications are a plus.

Core Competencies

  • Strategic territory planning and disciplined pipeline management.
  • Consultative selling — ability to diagnose business problems before proposing solutions.
  • Influence, persuasion, and consensus-building across complex enterprise buying committees.
  • Continuous learning mindset — genuinely curious about AI developments and their enterprise implications.
  • Clear, compelling written and verbal communication; strong presentation and proposal skills.
  • Relevant Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of experience and education.

What you will receive:

  • Love your career: Competitive total rewards package. Blog during work hours; take a day off and volunteer for your favorite charity.
  • Love your work/life balance: Flexibly work remotely from your home, there’s no daily travel requirement to an office! All you need is a stable internet connection.
  • Love your coworkers: Collaborate with some of the best and brightest in the industry!
  • Love your development: Hone your skills or learn new ones with our substantial training allowance; participate in professional development days, attend training, become certified, whatever you like!
  • Love your workspace: We give you all the equipment you need to work from home including a laptop with your choice of OS, and an annual budget to personalize your work environment!
  • Love yourself: Pythian cares about the health and well-being of our team. You will have an annual wellness budget to make yourself a priority (use it on gym memberships, massages, fitness and more). Additionally, you will receive a generous amount of paid vacation and sick days, as well as a day off to volunteer for your favorite charity.

  • The successful applicant will need to fulfill the requirements necessary to obtain a background check.
  • Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in any aspect of the selection process.

AI Disclaimer

Pythian may utilize Enterprise Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools or features throughout its hiring process. These tools help us manage high volumes of applications efficiently and may be employed to review applications, analyze resumes, and assist with other recruitment steps. While Pythian uses AI in its hiring process, it does not substitute for human judgment. Our Talent Acquisition Team reviews all AI-generated recommendations, and the system is subject to regular bias audits to ensure fairness and compliance with all applicable employment and human rights laws. All final hiring decisions are made by, and remain the responsibility of, human decision-makers. By applying for this position, you consent to Pythian’s use of these AI tools in the evaluation of your application. You have the right to request a human review of any solely AI-driven decision or to request an accommodation. Should you require further details regarding the processing of your data, please reach out to us.

We're building the future of Hybrid Healthcare and it starts with people like you.

Fresh Clinics empowers nurses and doctors to run thriving, compliant, and modern healthcare practices through our native iOS App, medical oversight, and human support behind them.

We're Australian founded, and in 7 years grown to 170+ Freshie's and support +2000 clinicians across Australia, and now scaling fast in the USA; all whilst staying true to what matters most: building safe, sustainable hybrid healthcare.

We're proud finalists in Deloitte’s Tech Fast 50 three years in a row and our culture is as bold as our mission: We work smart, hustle hard, stay humble, and lead with kindness.

If you’re looking for a workplace that celebrates our people, drives real-world impact, and champions innovation - welcome home.

About the role

We are seeking a highly responsive Medical Director to join our team as a dedicated physician partner. Fresh acts as the bridge between independent aesthetic practitioners and the complex regulatory landscape. In this role, you will provide medical governance and oversight for multiple practices and providers across the country, operating within state-specific regulatory limits.

This role is designed for a clinician who wants to move away from the "absentee" model and toward a "gold standard" of oversight that is reliable and deeply integrated into member safety. You will serve as the clinical safety net, providing the necessary authority for members to legally perform procedures and order professional-grade supplies.

What you'll do

This is a remote-first, high-execution role designed for a physician who can provide clinical agility across a diverse portfolio of medspas.

  • Protocol Approval: Approve and oversee clinical protocols for treatments including botulinum toxin, dermal fillers, IV therapy, and laser services.
  • Multi-Site Oversight: Supervise and delegate medical procedures to qualified staff (RNs, NPs, aestheticians) across multiple locations in compliance with state laws.
  • Standing Orders: Issue and annually review written Standing Delegation Orders (SDOs) and Standard Operating Protocols (SOPs) for delegated staff.
  • Operational Partnership: Support the Ops team by providing timely signatures and mandatory training certifications to get member supplier accounts active.
  • Chart Auditing: Log into the EMR to review a randomized 10% of patient charts monthly to ensure documentation standards are met.
  • Adverse Event (AE) Management: Remain available for critical complications and take responsibility for managing the patient until they are fully recovered.
  • Clinical Community: Attend ongoing webinars and the monthly USA Doctors’ “Morbidity and Most-Excellent-cases” meeting.

We'd love you to have

  • Multi-State Licensure: Must hold an active MD or DO license in good standing. Holding licenses in multiple states is highly preferred (top 10 states preferred).
  • Aesthetic Experience: Ideally 2+ years of exposure to aesthetic medicine (either as a practitioner or director).
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Basic knowledge of state-specific laws regarding delegation and supervision (Fresh provides internal management of complex regulatory landscapes).
  • Remote Proficiency: Experience using EMRs for chart auditing and the ability to manage digital signatures with 100% accuracy.
  • Board Certification: MD or DO in good standing; specialties like Plastic Surgery, Dermatology, or Family Medicine are ideal.
  • Insurance: Must carry malpractice insurance as required by state laws.

Who you are

  • A Senior Executor: You value your time and appreciate a model that automates administrative headaches so you can provide oversight from your laptop.
  • A Clinical Professional: You can quickly review a patient chart and identify if a safety risk exists.
  • Highly Responsive: You understand that timely email and document sign-offs are critical to the success of our members and the Ops team.
  • Problem Solver: You thrive in fast-paced environments and can manage the complexities of overseeing multiple providers across different time zones.

Why Fresh

  • Optimized Passive Income: High hourly value for a low active-time commitment—the "Holy Grail" for physicians.
  • Portfolio Career: Maintain your primary practice or retirement while staying relevant in the $15B+ aesthetics market.
  • Zero Overhead: Fresh handles the sales, billing, and member management.

🔗 Discover more here

Are you ready?

Apply now and tell us why you could be our next Freshie.

Your Perspective Matters

At Fresh, we believe that a diverse team is an innovative team. We are focused on creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences feel they belong and can thrive.

We strongly encourage you to apply, even if your past experience doesn’t perfectly align with every qualification listed. Your unique skills and passion could be just what we’re looking for, for this role or another.
